TL;DR: 本文分析Steam评论，考察标注AI披露的游戏是否与不同的评论模式相关联，发现AI披露游戏在负面评论中伴随更高程度的AI相关批评。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI在游戏开发中快速普及并引发激烈争论，玩家里反应是核心，但目前对玩家如何看待AI披露缺乏实证了解。

Method: 基于多个披露分组的Steam评论数据集，采用关键词分析、词频分析和特征词分析等语言分析方法，考察与AI相关的讨论。

Result: AI披露游戏与负面评论中更高水平的AI相关批评相关联。

Conclusion: 本研究是理解玩家如何感知AI披露的初步探索性一步，为相关讨论提供实证基础。

Abstract: The use of generative AI in game development is growing rapidly and is the subject of intense debate in which player reactions play a central role. This paper contributes to this discussion by analyzing Steam reviews to examine whether games with AI disclosure are associated with different review patterns. Using a dataset across multiple disclosure groups, we apply linguistic analysis including keyword-based, word frequency, and characteristic word analysis to investigate the AI-related discussion on Steam. Our results show that AI-disclosed games are associated with higher levels of AI-related criticism in negative reviews. Our findings provide a first exploratory step towards understanding how players perceive AI disclosure.

</details>


### [185] [QProtFuse: Query-Guided Layer Fusion for Retrieval-Augmented Protein Function Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30180)
*Mianzhi Pan,Peishuo Liu,Yawen Ouyang,Botian Wang,Yiming Rong,Hao Zhou,Jianbing Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 蛋白质功能预测对理解生物学过程至关重要。现有蛋白质RAG方法主攻外部检索信号，忽视单一PLM内部知识。作者发现PLM不同层与不同生物任务上的检索性能各异，末层选择并非最优，提出QProtFuse：以查询自适应融合多层蛋白特征，并通过模态内与跨模态对比目标联合学习蛋白与注释检索。在Prot-Inst-OOD上蛋白与注释检索均最优，注释重排后Recall@1达16.4%；下游RAG功能描述在Qwen3-8B与DeepSeek-V4-Pro上取得最高评分（6.22/10、6.68/10）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽能灵活生成自然语言功能描述，但蛋白质理解有限，需依赖RAG；而现有蛋白质RAG只扩展外部检索信号，忽略单个PLM内部编码的丰富知识，且默认取末层表示，未考虑层间与任务间的差异。

Method: 提出QProtFuse：用查询自适应融合PLM多层蛋白特征；联合学习蛋白检索与注释检索，采用模态内与跨模态对比目标训练。

Result: 在Prot-Inst-OOD上蛋白与注释检索分数均为最佳，注释重排后Recall@1达16.4%；下游RAG功能描述获得最高LLM-as-a-judge评分：Qwen3-8B 6.22/10，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 6.68/10；消融与权重分析验证了查询引导融合及互补训练目标的价值。

Conclusion: 查询引导的多层特征融合与互补对比目标能有效挖掘PLM内部知识，提升检索及下游RAG功能描述质量。

Abstract: Predicting protein functions from amino acid sequences is essential to understanding biological processes. Large language models (LLMs) offer flexible function descriptions to natural-language queries, yet their limited protein understanding motivates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Existing protein RAG methods primarily expand external retrieval signals while overlooking the rich knowledge encoded within a single protein language model (PLM). We show that retrieval performance varies across PLM layers and biological tasks, making conventional final-layer selection suboptimal. To this end, we propose QProtFuse, which uses queries to adaptively fuse multi-layer protein features and jointly learns protein and annotation retrieval through intra-modal and cross-modal contrastive objectives. On Prot-Inst-OOD, QProtFuse achieves the best protein and annotation retrieval scores, reaching 16.4\% Recall@1 with annotation reranking. These gains improve downstream RAG-based function descriptions, yielding the highest LLM-as-a-judge scores for both Qwen3-8B (6.22/10) and DeepSeek-V4-Pro (6.68/10). Ablations and weight analyses demonstrate the value of query-guided fusion and complementary training objectives for exploiting a PLM's internal knowledge.

</details>


### [186] [FAIRGate: Agentic Runtime Policy Selection and Verified Repair for Fairer Recommendation Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30359)
*Navkar Jain,Enock Ayiku,Kenneth Fletcher*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出FAIRGate——一种与基础排序模型无关的“代理式策略选择层”，在基排序器与最终Top-K之间动态选择公平性策略，由确定性执行器与校验器保证公平约束可测、有界、可复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平感知推荐多在训练中固化单一公平目标，或打分后套用固定重排规则；但部署时候选池、物品元数据、曝光债务、用户偏好历史与效用预算都在运行时变化，合适的公平动作需随请求而变。

Method: FAIRGate置于基排序器与最终Top-K列表之间。代理不自行定义公平目标，而是从预定义策略库（长尾曝光、群体曝光均衡、集中度控制、校准保护、弃权）中选择策略；确定性执行器通过约束修复实施所选策略；校验器仅在相关性、可行性、元数据、校准与审计约束均满足时接受结果；语言模型仅在排序决策固定后，基于已核验的审计轨迹生成带证据链接的叙述。

Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅说明该设计使代理承担运行时责任，同时保持公平执行的可度量、有界与可复现。

Conclusion: FAIRGate以“策略选择—确定性执行—约束校验—事后叙述”的分层架构，将代理的灵活性局限于策略选择，兼顾运行时自适应与公平执行的可靠性、可审计性。

Abstract: Fairness-aware recommender systems often encode one fairness objective during training or apply a fixed re-ranking rule after scoring. In deployment, however, the appropriate fairness action can vary across requests because the candidate pool, item metadata, exposure debt, user preference history, and utility budget all change at runtime. We propose FAIRGate, a model-agnostic delivery controller that places an agentic policy-selection layer between a base ranker and the final top-K list. The agent does not define fairness objectives from scratch. It chooses from a predefined policy library covering long-tail exposure, item-group exposure balance, concentration control, calibration protection, and abstention. A deterministic executor then applies the selected policy through constrained repair, and a validator accepts the result only when relevance, feasibility, metadata, calibration, and audit constraints are satisfied. The final language-model component receives only the verified audit trace and produces evidence-linked narration after the ranking decision is fixed. This design gives the agent runtime responsibility while keeping fairness enforcement measurable, bounded, and replayable.

</details>


### [187] [When Agentic Retrieval Fails Silently: Framework and Production Evidence from a Creative AI Assistant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30423)
*Yan,Liang,Anuj Agarwal,Aditya Reddy Cheruku*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文指出在智能体助手场景中，CTR、MRR 与行为 NDCG 等传统检索指标失效，提出"归因鸿沟"问题与三层评估框架 LARA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统检索评估假设用户直接看到并作用于排序结果。但在智能体助手中，生成层先消费检索输出，导致三方面假设失效：谁先读（智能体先于用户）、何时行动（可跨轮次/会话）、结果归因（模型自身知识与检索内容混杂），即"归因鸿沟"。

Method: 提出 Layered Agentic Retrieval Assessment（LARA），将检索质量、参与度与结果、产品成功作为三个独立层，用四字段血缘模式（lineage schema）连接，无需新建模。并在 Adobe Express 上验证动机：同一检索基础设施同时服务图库搜索与智能体助手，后者约为其会话量的 1/8。

Result: 聊天用户重述（reformulation）比例高于图库用户（44.4% vs 33.1%），因为聊天中的重述旨在精炼生成输出而非检索查询本身。

Conclusion: LARA 在无需额外建模的前提下为检索恢复了归因能力，为智能体场景下的检索评估提供了可行框架。

Abstract: CTR, MRR, and behavioral NDCG assume the user sees ranked results and acts on them. In an agentic assistant, a generation layer consumes retrieval output first, and that assumption breaks in three ways. The agent reads the results before the user does (who). The user's action can come several turns or sessions after retrieval (when). Outcomes blend retrieved content with the model's own knowledge (what caused it). We call this the attribution gap. We propose Layered Agentic Retrieval Assessment (LARA), which measures retrieval quality, engagement and outcome, and product success as three independent layers joined by a four-field lineage schema that requires no new modeling. We examine the motivation on Adobe Express, where one retrieval infrastructure serves a gallery search surface and an agentic assistant at roughly one-eighth its session volume for the same user population. Chat users reformulate more than gallery users (44.4% vs. 33.1%) because chat reformulation refines generated output. LARA restores attribution for the retrieval.

</details>


### [188] [Getting a GRIP on Graph-Based Search for Learned Sparse Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30425)
*Vihan Lakshman,Franco Maria Nardini,Cosimo Rulli,Rossano Venturini*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文挑战"倒排索引优于图索引用于学习稀疏检索(LSR)"的共识，提出GRIP系统，通过三项技术将倒排索引的优势融入图搜索，在MS MARCO v2 (138M) 上比SOTA倒排索引Seismic在95% recall@10下快2.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作表明经改造的倒排索引在LSR上取得SOTA召回-延迟权衡，学界普遍认为图索引不如倒排索引。作者认为这一结论源于直接套用标准图ANN的缺陷，而非图搜索本身的问题。

Method: 提出GRIP图ANN系统，包含三项技术：(i) 基于词的入口点种子选取；(ii) 通过稀疏草图(sparse sketching)进行近似路由；(iii) 基于稀疏划分的图构建。

Result: 在MS MARCO v2（138M段落）与SPLADE嵌入下，GRIP在95% recall@10时比SOTA LSR倒排索引Seismic延迟降低2.5倍。

Conclusion: 结果质疑了将倒排索引作为LSR部署默认选择的惯例，表明融合倒排索引优势的图索引可超越倒排索引。

Abstract: Learned sparse retrieval (LSR) has recently gained traction in the information retrieval community for the ability to combine the generalization capabilities of neural representations with the interpretability of keyword-based search. A number of recent works have demonstrated that inverted indexes, when appropriately modified for learned sparse embeddings, achieve state-of-the-art recall-latency tradeoffs for LSR, often outperforming graph-based indexes by substantial margins in latency at a fixed recall target. As a result, the community has generally concluded that graph-based approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search is inferior to inverted indexes for LSR. This paper challenges this conventional wisdom. Our key insight is that, while applying standard graph-based ANN indexes out-of-the-box to sparse vectors leads to uncompetitive performance, we can overcome these shortcomings by infusing the strengths of inverted indexes into graph-based search. In particular, we introduce three techniques to accelerate graph-based LSR: (i) term-based entry point seeding, (ii) approximate routing via sparse sketching, and (iii) sparse partition-based graph construction. We combine these techniques into a new graph-based ANN system for LSR we call GRIP. On the MS MARCO v2 benchmark (138M passages) with SPLADE embeddings, GRIP achieves a $2.5\times$ latency improvement over Seismic, a state-of-the-art inverted index tailored for LSR, at 95\% recall@10. Ultimately, our results call into question the default choice of inverted indexes for deploying learned sparse retrieval.

</details>


### [189] [The Fusion Tax: A Diagnostic Analysis of When Hybrid Retrieval Hurts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30612)
*Aaditya Chauhan,Arun Agarwal*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文质疑"混合检索总是值得推荐"的通行做法，提出"融合税（fusion tax）"概念：融合在总体指标上获益，却会在部分查询上让排序变差。基于7个BEIR数据集、多种编码器与3种融合函数的系统实验，作者量化了该损失并给出以稀疏-稠密平衡为依据的融合决策指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合检索（稀疏BM25 + 稠密神经检索，常用RRF）因聚合指标提升而被广泛推荐，但缺乏对"单条查询上融合带来的损失"的考察；作者主张应把"不融合"视为一等选项，并在真实部署条件下审视融合的代价。

Method: 标准Anserini BM25 + 5个稠密编码器（22M–596M参数、跨三代模型）+ 学习稀疏式SPLADE替代 + 交叉编码器二阶段重排；在7个BEIR数据集、3种融合函数上评测，并采用留一语料库验证选权重、以及损失厌恶的风险敏感评估。以"最佳组件"和"仅稠密"为对照基准量化逐查询损失。

Result: 最佳方法（稠密加权分数插值）仍有13–48%查询排在两组件较优者之下，8–21%查询低于可部署的仅稠密检索器（交叉验证选权重时为14–48%与11–25%）；在主编码器下它在所有语料总体指标上优于仅稠密，但7个语料中6个在风险敏感评估下显著为负。该损失主要是排序效应、总体召回不变；最可能出现在仅单一检索器召回的查询上；在编码器规模和SPLADE替换下持续存在。稠密明显更强时RRF税更高，仅在两者均衡时优于仅稠密。融合失败在同语料内弱可预测、跨语料迁移不可靠（预测特征随稀疏-稠密平衡变号）；交叉编码器仅在其自身可靠时才挽回部分损失。

Conclusion: 混合检索的聚合收益掩盖了逐查询的非对称损失（融合税），且RRF并非普遍最优；应把融合决策与目标语料实测的稀疏-稠密平衡挂钩，并将"不融合"纳入常规选择。

Abstract: Hybrid retrieval, which fuses a sparse lexical retriever with a dense neural one, is widely recommended in the software documentation surveyed in September 2026, usually with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), on the strength of aggregate gains. We ask what fusion costs on individual queries, treating "do not fuse" as a first-class outcome, in the setting in which hybrid retrieval is deployed: a standard Anserini BM25, five dense encoders spanning 22M-596M parameters and three model generations, a learned-sparse (SPLADE) alternative, and a cross-encoder second stage, on seven BEIR datasets and three fusion functions. Even the best method, dense-weighted score interpolation, ranks relevant documents below the better of its two components on 13-48% of queries and below the deployable dense-only retriever on 8-21% (14-48% and 11-25% at a weight selected under leave-one-corpus-out validation), while beating dense-only in aggregate on every corpus with the primary encoder; the downside is significant under loss-averse risk-sensitive evaluation on six of the seven corpora. We call this loss the fusion tax. It is mostly a ranking effect that preserves recall in aggregate, it is most likely on the queries that only one retriever covers, and it persists across the encoder ladder and the SPLADE substitution. RRF carries the higher tax wherever the dense retriever is clearly stronger and only beats dense-only where the two components are balanced. Fusion failure is weakly predictable within a corpus but transfers unreliably across corpora, because the features that predict it change sign with the sparse-dense balance. A cross-encoder recovers part of the tax only where it is itself reliable. We distill these findings into guidance that keys the fusion decision to the measured sparse-dense balance of the target corpus.

</details>


### [190] [OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30675)
*Hao Jiang,Peiru Du,Pengfei Yao,Mengting Li,Siyuan Lou,Kuo Cai,Sheng Yu,Qiang Luo,Jian Liang,Ruiming Tang,Fei Pan,Peng Jiang,Wenwu Ou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 OneLatent，一种将显式 CoT 推理轨迹压缩为可学习隐式 token 的高效潜在推理框架，在快手工业场景中兼顾效果与 17 倍以上推理吞吐提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有以 LLM 为底座的基础推荐模型依赖显式 Chain-of-Thought（Think-then-Answer），但生成冗长推理链带来巨大推理开销，且依赖人工模板，难以刻画多样、动态的用户兴趣。

Method: 1) Multi-View Adaptive CoT（MV-ACoT）：多视角探索用户兴趣并自适应调整每样本推理复杂度，生成多样且高质量的教师监督；2) 基于预训练 FRM 的三阶段潜在 token 对齐范式，逐步将 CoT 轨迹内化为可学习 latent token；3) 多阶段课程式后训练策略，激活隐式 token 推理能力以适配下游推荐任务。

Result: 在工业级快手数据集与公开 Kuaishou LLM-Rec 基准上稳定优于显式 CoT 方法与传统基线；相较 FRM 的 Think 与 No-Think 变体，SID@64 分别提升 17.44% 和 9.33%，在线推理吞吐提升超 17 倍。线上 A/B 测试（快手本地服务广告）相较 OneRec、OneReason 等强基线估计带来 9.6% 收入提升。

Conclusion: 隐式潜在推理可在不生成显式推理链的前提下保留甚至增强推理收益，实现效果与效率双赢，并已构建可规模化实时部署的生产服务系统，验证了工业可行性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning under a Think-then-Answer paradigm. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse, dynamic user interests. We propose OneLatent, an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens, enabling Latent-Reason-then-Answer inference without generating verbose traces. OneLatent first introduces Multi-View Adaptive CoT (MV-ACoT), which creates diverse, high-quality teacher-generated supervision by exploring user interests from multiple perspectives and automatically adapting reasoning complexity to each instance. Building on pretrained FRMs, it then uses a three-stage latent-token alignment paradigm to progressively internalize CoT traces into learnable latent tokens. Finally, a multistage curriculum-based post-training strategy activates latent-token reasoning for downstream recommendation tasks. Experiments on an industrial-scale Kuaishou dataset and the public Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark show that OneLatent consistently outperforms explicit CoT-based methods and traditional baselines. Compared with the Think and No-Think variants of FRMs, OneLatent improves SID@64 by 17.44% and 9.33%, respectively, while achieving over 17x higher online inference throughput. We further develop a production serving system for scalable, real-time FRM inference. An online A/B test in Kuaishou's local-services advertising scenario shows that deploying OneLatent with this system yields an estimated 9.6% revenue lift over strong online baselines, including OneRec and OneReason.

</details>


### [191] [Lychee: Certified Screening of Inverted Lists for High-Recall Vector Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30697)
*Dongfang Zhao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Lychee 是一种 GPU 倒排索引检索方法，通过"认证排除"在不读取完整向量的情况下判定大多数候选不可能进入 top-k，从而在极高召回（0.999–0.9999）下大幅加速十亿级向量近邻搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人脸比对、欺诈检测、医学影像匹配等应用漏检一个近邻就意味着漏掉威胁、欺诈或诊断，因此需要 0.999–0.9999 的召回。但精确搜索太贵；倒排索引虽可通过探测更多列表提升召回，却要对每个探测向量全精度读取打分，吞吐随探测列表数反比下降；图索引达不到该召回目标，量化列表又须用全向量重排。

Method: 核心洞察：借助"认证排除"给出的精确搜索下界，在读取向量之前就判定绝大多数被探测向量不可能进入被探测列表的 top-k。Lychee 在 GPU 张量核上，用同列表锚点导出的阈值对探测列表进行筛选，只对极少数幸存者计算精确距离。

Result: 证明 Lychee 返回的恰是被探测列表的 k 个最近向量（即全精度倒排搜索的答案），且无论探测多少列表，每次查询只读取数百个完整向量。在 11 个数据集（100 万至 10 亿向量）上与 10 个 GPU/CPU 基线对比：对 ≤1 亿向量数据集，相同召回下比 IVF-Flat（200 列表）快 9.7–117 倍；达到 CAGRA 和 HNSW 无法达到的召回水平；超过 1000 万向量时比认证排除精确搜索快 5–18 倍。四 GPU 上以 0.9999 召回检索 10 亿向量，在 BIGANN-1B 上比 IVF-Flat 快 44.5 倍。

Conclusion: 通过"先排除、后精算"的筛选范式，Lychee 在保持倒排搜索结果精确性的同时把读取量降到常数级，兼顾了极高召回与高吞吐，在超大规模向量检索上显著优于现有 GPU/CPU 方案。

Abstract: Nearest-neighbor search over embedding vectors matches faces against watchlists, transactions against known fraud patterns, and medical images against confirmed cases, where a missed neighbor is a missed threat, fraud, or diagnosis. Because an approximate index cannot report which queries lost a true neighbor, these applications require recall of 0.999 to 0.9999, at a cost far below that of exact search over billions of vectors. Inverted-file indexes reach high recall by probing more lists, but they read and score every probed vector at full precision, so that throughput falls in inverse proportion to the number of probed lists. Graph indexes saturate below these targets, whereas quantized lists must rerank their candidates with the full vectors. Our insight is to decide for almost every probed vector that it cannot enter the top k of the probed lists without reading the vector, through the certified lower bound of exact search by certified exclusion. This paper turns this insight into Lychee, a GPU inverted-file search that screens the probed lists on tensor cores under a threshold from anchors of the same lists and computes exact distances only for the few survivors. We prove that Lychee returns exactly the k nearest vectors of the probed lists, the answer of an inverted-file search at full precision, while it reads a few hundred full vectors per query regardless of the number of probed lists. On eleven datasets from one million to one billion vectors and against ten GPU and CPU baselines, Lychee is 9.7 to 117 times faster than IVF-Flat at equal recall with 200 probed lists on datasets of up to 100 million vectors. It also reaches recall levels that CAGRA and HNSW do not reach and outruns exact search by certified exclusion by 5 to 18 times above ten million vectors. On four GPUs, Lychee searches one billion vectors at recall 0.9999, 44.5 times faster than IVF-Flat on BIGANN-1B.

</details>


### [192] [Automated Enrichment Analysis with GraphRAG: Efficient Multi-Database ORA Extraction and Biological Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30710)
*Guangcan Li,Shuyuan Zheng,Jiayao Liu,Shigeto Seno,Makoto Onizuka*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: GBOR-RAG是一个整合多源基因集数据库、基于统一术语-基因知识图谱的可追溯ORA解读框架：图式ORA打分后检索紧凑连通证据子图作为LLM条件，并引入断言级忠实度指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ORA输出在不同基因集数据库间碎片化，且仅以扁平条目列表呈现，掩盖了相关富集信号之间的基因级联系，缺乏整合性与可追溯性。

Method: 将异构基因集数据库表示为统一的术语-基因知识图谱（共享基因连接跨源相关术语）；进行图式ORA打分；检索保留跨库关系与基因级支撑的紧凑连通证据子图；以该子图条件化LLM生成生物学解释；提出断言级忠实度指标评估生成断言是否有显式证据支持。

Result: 图式ORA与传统ORA高度一致（平均Pearson r=0.997），查询时间中位降低37倍（最高48倍）；检索子图平均36.8个节点，整合得分最高（4.12）；GBOR-RAG断言级忠实度最高（0.90）；加入PubMed文献层后整体解读质量由4.17提升至4.75。

Conclusion: 将多库基因集统一为知识图谱并以连通证据子图驱动LLM，可在保持ORA结果一致性和大幅提速的同时提升整合性、可追溯性与忠实度，且可借助文献层进一步增强解读质量。

Abstract: Over-representation analysis (ORA) is widely used to interpret gene-expression studies, but its outputs are often fragmented across gene-set databases and presented as flat term lists that obscure gene-level links among related enrichment signals. We propose Graph-Based Over-Representation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GBOR-RAG), an integrated and traceable framework for ORA interpretation. GBOR-RAG represents heterogeneous gene-set databases as a unified term--gene knowledge graph, where shared genes connect related terms across sources. After graph-based ORA scoring, the framework retrieves a compact connected evidence subgraph that preserves both cross-database relationships and gene-level support. The subgraph conditions an LLM to generate biological interpretations, and we introduce a claim-level faithfulness metric to assess whether generated claims are supported by explicit evidence. Experiments show that graph-based ORA preserves conventional ORA results with high consistency (mean Pearson $r=0.997$) while reducing query time by a median of $37\times$ (up to $48\times$). The retrieved subgraphs average 36.8 nodes and achieve the highest overall integration score (4.12), and GBOR-RAG attains the highest claim-level faithfulness (0.90) among the compared systems. Adding a PubMed literature layer further improves the overall interpretation quality from 4.17 to 4.75.

</details>


### [193] [Bezier-Guided Adaptive Flow for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30825)
*Ziang Lu,Yu Zhang,Xinzhe Jiang,Lei Sang,Yiwen Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 BGAFlow，一个面向跨域序列推荐的个性化框架，结合状态自适应语义演化与用户级迁移控制，通过 LLM 推断用户画像、个性化迁移视界估计以及条件 Bezier 曲线引导的残差流学习，实现更灵活有效的偏好迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨域序列推荐旨在通过跨域迁移偏好知识缓解数据稀疏与冷启动问题。但用户跨域偏好一致性程度存在差异，现有方法多依赖全局对齐目标或粗粒度迁移策略，容易引入无关信息，且难以针对个体用户灵活调整语义表示。

Method: 1) 通过统一双域预训练并利用 LLM 推断用户画像，建立共享语义空间；2) 基于潜在兴趣重叠度估计个性化"视界"（horizon），确定每位用户合适的迁移程度；3) 构造条件 Bezier 曲线作为几何参考，学习残差流基于中间偏好状态逐步精化轨迹；4) 流中引入动态偏好反馈调整迁移方向，并用推荐监督与轨迹正则化保证有效且平滑的适应。

Result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，BGAFlow 持续优于当前最优基线，验证了个性化迁移控制与状态自适应语义演化的有效性。

Conclusion: BGAFlow 通过个性化迁移控制与状态自适应语义演化，克服了全局对齐与粗粒度迁移的局限，为跨域序列推荐提供了更灵活、更精准的偏好迁移方案。

Abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to alleviate data sparsity and cold-start problems by transferring useful preference knowledge across domains. However, users exhibit varying degrees of preference consistency across domains, while existing methods often rely on global alignment objectives or coarse-grained transfer strategies. Such approaches may introduce irrelevant information and provide limited flexibility in adapting semantic representations to individual user preferences. To address these challenges, we propose BGAFlow, a personalized framework that combines state-adaptive semantic evolution with user-specific transfer control. BGAFlow first establishes a shared semantic space through unified dual-domain pretraining with user profiles inferred by a large language model (LLM). Based on latent interest overlap, it then estimates a personalized horizon to determine the appropriate transfer extent for each user. To enable semantic adaptation, BGAFlow constructs a conditional Bezier curve as a geometric reference and learns a residual flow that progressively refines the trajectory based on intermediate preference states. The learned flow incorporates dynamic preference feedback to adjust transfer directions, while recommendation supervision and trajectory regularization encourage effective and smooth adaptation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that BGAFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the benefits of personalized transfer control and state-adaptive semantic evolution.

</details>


### [194] [UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30932)
*Jujia Zhao,Jiakai Tang,Jing Yu,Wen Chen,Jian Wu,Han Zhu,Fei Sun,Suzan Verberne,Zhaochun Ren*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 UserArena，一个含 64,729 条真实电商会话轨迹的交互式推荐基准，支持离线对标生产 A/B 结果的五级评估，并提出 On-Policy Trajectory Distillation (OPTD) 提升长程模拟器保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic 推荐的开发与评估需要能同时刻画交互式购物环境和用户长程行为响应的推荐世界模型，但现有资源缺乏长时程、细粒度真实用户轨迹，也缺少轨迹级评估与对生产 A/B 结果的离线验证能力。

Method: 构建 UserArena 基准（11,010 用户、64,729 条会话轨迹、566,102 个物品、13 类动作），配套可交互环境与五级评估协议（输出有效性、局部决策、序列行为、个性化、最终结果）；同时提出 OPTD，以轨迹级意图在 student 生成的 rollouts 上提供密集 teacher 目标。

Result: 在 UserArena 评估协议下，OPTD 在所评估的模拟器中取得最佳整体保真度，并在离线仿真中最接近复现生产策略效果。

Conclusion: 真实轨迹 + 交互环境 + 可对标 A/B 的评估体系构成了推荐世界模型研究的可行基础设施，轨迹级蒸馏是提升长程模拟保真度的有效手段。

Abstract: Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Developing and evaluating such policies requires faithful recommendation world models that capture both the interactive shopping environment and users' behavioral responses over long interactions. Existing resources rarely provide long-horizon, fine-grained real-user trajectories or support trajectory-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B results. We introduce UserArena, a real-world e-commerce interactive benchmark containing 64,729 session trajectories from 11,010 users, spanning 566,102 items and 13 action types. UserArena pairs these trajectories with an interactive environment and supports offline validation against outcomes from a controlled production A/B test, enabling five-level evaluation from output validity and local decisions to sequential behavior, personalization, and outcomes. To improve simulator fidelity over these long-horizon interactions, we further propose On-Policy Trajectory Distillation (OPTD), which uses trajectory-level intent to provide dense teacher targets on student-generated rollouts. Experiments show that OPTD achieves the strongest overall fidelity among the evaluated simulators under UserArena's evaluation protocol and most closely reproduces the production policy effect in offline simulation.

</details>


### [195] [PAIR: Preference-Aligned Intent Retrieval for Premium People Recommendation at LinkedIn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30941)
*Zhongkai Shangguan,Yanbin Kang,Yihan Cao,Ruijie Jiang,Qiannan Yin,Chang Yue,Zijian Zhou,Girish Kathalagiri,Changshuai Wei,Zhengming Xing*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PAIR：用偏好对齐的意图检索（曝光条件多负样本对比目标）替代画像相似度，解决职业网络中互补性匹配问题，并在LinkedIn Premium检索任务上以0.6B模型达到MAR@100=0.45。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 职业网络（如LinkedIn）的互动是目标驱动的跨角色互补行为（求职者更愿意联系招聘者而非同类候选人），因此基于画像相似度或社交信号的通用嵌入与好友型社交网络的推荐方法会错误排序候选。需要建模用户意图偏好而非相似度或社交邻近性。

Method: 受DPO偏好学习视角启发，将其实例化为嵌入空间的曝光条件多负样本对比目标，无需显式参考模型，训练简洁且可扩展到大候选集；同时用带位置编码的点击历史聚合引入交互序列，捕获时间顺序，在固定历史窗口上以常数代价更新用户表示，新交互无需重编码历史，服务时仅用轻量CPU操作即可更新个性化，无需重复LLM推理。

Result: 在LinkedIn Premium检索任务上评估，0.6B参数模型取得MAR@100=0.45。

Conclusion: 偏好对齐的意图检索优于相似度/社交信号范式，能以较小模型和高效服务实现有效的职业网络个性化检索。

Abstract: General-purpose embeddings trained on profile similarity often misrank candidates in professional networks, where relevance is inherently complementary rather than symmetric. For example, job seekers usually engage with recruiters rather than peers with similar credentials. Current user recommendation systems are often built on profile similarity or social signals such as shared connections, which are effective in friend-oriented social networks where users tend to connect with similar people or within existing social circles. However, this does not hold in professional platforms like LinkedIn, where interactions are often goal-driven and cross-role interactions, requiring matching based on complementary intents rather than similarity or social proximity. In this paper, we propose Preference-Aligned Intent Retrieval, a retrieval framework that is designed to model user intent preference instead of profile similarity. Our approach is inspired by the preference-learning perspective of Direct Preference Optimization, but instantiates preference learning as an exposure-conditioned multi-negative contrastive objective over embeddings. This formulation simplifies training and scales efficiently to large candidate sets without requiring an explicit reference model. Furthermore, we incorporate user interaction history by aggregating click histories with positional encoding to capture temporal order, which enables constant-cost updates of user representations over a fixed history window, allowing new interactions to be incorporated without re-encoding history. As a result, personalization can be updated efficiently using lightweight CPU operations without repeated LLM inference during serving. We evaluate PAIR on LinkedIn's Premium retrieval task. A 0.6B parameter model achieves a MAR@100 of 0.45.

</details>


### [196] [Formal-Informal Mathematical Alignment through and beyond Human Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31011)
*Noah Gießing,Ankit Satpute,Hamid Rahkooy,André Greiner-Petter,Moritz Schubotz*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 构建Stacks Project非形式化陈述与Lean mathlib形式化的对齐数据集，并用检索、LLM重排与LLM辅助验证发现新的非形式-形式链接，最终整合进MaRDI知识图谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化数学库（如mathlib）与非形式数学资源之间连接稀疏且缺乏系统性，若能有效关联，可揭示数学概念间隐含联系并提升现有形式化的可访问性。

Method: 利用专家标注构建Stacks Project语句到mathlib形式化的数据集；评估检索、LLM重排和LLM辅助验证三种手段以发现未标注的非形式-形式链接；将新发现的对齐整合进MaRDI知识图谱。

Result: 基于专家标注建立了非形式-形式对齐数据集，并通过检索+LLM重排+LLM验证流程发现新的未标注链接，且将其纳入MaRDI知识图谱以供数学家查找形式对应物。

Conclusion: 该工作迈出非形式与形式数学整合的第一步，同时指出现有LLM在连接形式与非形式数学内容方面仍存在困难与挑战，并提供可复现代码与数据。

Abstract: Formalized mathematics libraries such as Lean's \texttt{mathlib} provide machine-verifiable representations of mathematical knowledge, including definitions, theorems, and their relationships. If effectively connected to informal mathematical resources, formal mathematics could help uncover previously implicit links between mathematical concepts and improve access to existing formalizations. However, connections between informal and formal mathematics libraries are currently sparse and unsystematic. In this paper, we make first strides towards better formal integration. We construct a dataset linking informal statements from the Stacks Project to their formalizations in \texttt{mathlib} by exploiting expert annotations. We evaluate retrieval, LLM-based reranking, and LLM-assisted verification to discover new unannotated informal-to-formal links. To facilitate exploration and reuse of formalized knowledge, we integrated the newly discovered alignments into the MaRDI knowledge graph, enabling mathematicians to find formal counterparts to informal mathematical content. We discuss the difficulties and challenges in using LLMs for linking formal and informal mathematical content. All code and data necessary for reproducing this paper can be found at: https://github.com/AnkitSatpute/Formal-Informal-Mathematical-Alignment

</details>


### [197] [The Delayed Countdown Method for Validating Review-Oriented AI Workflows in eDiscovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31311)
*David D. Lewis,Tara Emory,Lenora Gray,Mark Noel,Jeremy Pickens,Eugene Yang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文针对电子取证中"面向审阅"的AI辅助工作流效果验证争议，提出Delayed Countdown方法，可嵌入现有流程、兼容任意停止规则，并能给出有效的频率学派置信区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在eDiscovery中，面向审阅的工作流已成为AI辅助文档审阅的主流方式，但其有效性如何验证一直是技术辅助审阅（TAR）领域含糊且充满争议的问题。论文旨在剖析争议来源并给出简单实用的评估方案。

Method: 提出Delayed Countdown方法：可便捷地集成进现有面向审阅的工作流与软件，兼容任意停止规则，并对工作流有效性生成有效的频率学派置信区间。文中给出了方法的理论基础、示例计算，并讨论了逻辑上不可能的召回值（impossible recall values）的处理方式。

Result: 方法在理论上能够对审阅工作流的有效性给出有效的置信区间估计；通过示例计算展示了具体操作；对不可能召回值情形给出了处理说明。

Conclusion: Delayed Countdown为面向审阅的TAR工作流提供了一种实用、通用且统计上有效的评估途径；未来工作方向包括降低审阅成本。

Abstract: Review-oriented workflows have become the dominant approach to AI-assisted document review in electronic discovery (eDiscovery). How to validate the effectiveness of review-oriented workflows has, however, remained a confusing and controversial topic in technology-assisted review (TAR) in the law. We examine the sources of this controversy, and propose a simple and practical evaluation approach for review-oriented workflows. Our Delayed Countdown method is easily incorporated into existing review-oriented workflows and software, is compatible with arbitrary stopping rules, and produces valid frequentist confidence intervals on effectiveness. We explain the conceptual foundations of the method, provide example computations, discuss the handling of logically impossible recall values, and suggest future work on decreasing review costs.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [198] [Agentic Verified Optimization of Real-World Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30188)
*Zhe Ye,Udaya Ghai,Zhizhen Qin,Dawn Song,Soonho Kong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出"智能体验证优化"任务：智能体在生成更快实现的同时，给出机器可检验的与原实现等价的 Lean 4 证明，并在函数级与真实迁移应用上取得实证成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体可以靠改算法、数据结构、执行策略让程序变快，但等价性检查主要依赖测试，智能体常被证明会"钻测试的空子"——通过测试却不保持预期行为。另一方面，验证式代码生成面临"写规格说明"的瓶颈；由于原实现本身可充当规格，把优化任务转化为"产出更快实现+等价性证明"即可绕开该瓶颈，而定理证明的进展使证明变得可行。

Method: 1）在 Lean 4 中界定函数级与仓库级两类任务，使程序既可执行又可推理；2）针对真实应用很少用 Lean 书写的问题，开发智能体框架 Aqueduct，将 C、C++、Go、Rust 程序迁移为原生 Lean，并用与原程序的差分测试验证每次移植；3）在原实现即规格的设定下，让智能体产出更快实现及机器检验的等价证明。

Result: 在 Verina 的 189 个参考实现上，智能体为 156 个产出了更快的带证明重写，其中包含把指数递归替换为动态规划等算法级改动；在 17 个迁移应用上，92 个带证明重写使 51 个应用场景中的 47 个加速。应用层收益小于函数层收益，说明"选择优化哪些函数"本身是个重要问题。

Conclusion: 现有智能体已能在独立函数与由真实程序迁移而来的应用上完成验证优化；论文最后讨论了剩余挑战及走向生产环境验证优化的路径，并指出函数选择/收益传递是应用层的关键瓶颈。

Abstract: Program optimization aims to improve performance while preserving behavior. Coding agents can already make programs faster by changing algorithms, data structures, and execution strategies. However, existing equivalence checks mostly rely on tests, which agents have been shown to exploit, passing the tests without preserving the intended behavior. We propose agentic verified optimization, in which an agent produces a faster implementation together with a machine-checked proof of equivalence to the existing one. Because the existing implementation serves as the specification, the task avoids the specification-writing bottleneck of verified code generation, and recent advances in theorem proving make the proofs attainable. We formulate the task at the function and repository levels in Lean 4, where programs can be both executed and reasoned about. Few real-world applications are written in Lean, so we develop Aqueduct, an agentic framework that migrates C, C++, Go, and Rust programs into native Lean, validates each port by differential testing against its original. On the 189 reference implementations in Verina, agents produce faster proved rewrites for 156, including algorithmic changes such as replacing exponential recursion with dynamic programming. On 17 migrated applications, their 92 proved rewrites speed up 47 of 51 application scenarios. These application-level gains are smaller than the function-level ones, making the choice of functions to optimize an important problem. Current agents can thus already carry out verified optimization on both standalone functions and applications migrated from real programs. We discuss the remaining challenges and the steps toward verified optimization in production.

</details>


### [199] [Detection Is Not Enough: Reasoning Traces as Testable Program Hypotheses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30200)
*Vaidehi Hegde*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在用冻结的 LLaMA-2-7B-chat 在 GSM8K 上做的参考无关推理链验证研究中，检测并非瓶颈：自一致性/自校验类检测 AUROC 仅 0.741 且存在结构性上限，而候选衍生的变形探针（对问题量扰动后重写执行）能区分正确/错误轨迹（60.6% vs 31.6% 基线），但修复率过低，没有任何策略带来显著准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署时的语言模型没有参考解，其推理轨迹是判断答案的唯一证据；现有无参考替代方案各有缺陷（自评估损害答案、采样一致性只测稳定性、扰动研究依赖人写模板），因此需要研究在无参考解、无评判模型、不更新权重条件下单条轨迹能验证到什么程度。

Method: 在冻结的 LLaMA-2-7B-chat 与 GSM8K 上：(1) 轨迹自我一致性检验，达到 AUROC 0.741 后因结构性原因停滞；(2) 候选衍生变形探针：将轨迹抽象为问题量的程序，扰动一个量、执行程序，并对改写后的问题让模型回答一次，使每条轨迹自带测试；(3) 分析重试策略的收益条件：检测精度需超过 D/(R+D)，其中 R 为重试修复错误率、D 为损害正确率。

Result: 自我一致性检测 AUROC 0.741 为上限：2/3 的错误轨迹未陈述错误方程（正确执行了错误计划），且在错误计划失败上检测器反而更少标记错误轨迹。变形探针在 1,319 道测试题中 937 道（71.0%）存在有效扰动；其中 847 道有可解析首条轨迹，支持性轨迹正确率 60.6%（基线 31.6%），但探针也否证了 45.5% 的正确轨迹。无任何测试策略带来统计显著的准确率提升。

Conclusion: 在无参考解条件下，检测不是瓶颈，修复才是开放问题：修复率过低导致同样重试预算下即便完美检测器也只能挽回约 66/1,319 道题，未来工作应聚焦于轨迹修复而非检测。

Abstract: When a language model is deployed, no reference solution exists, so the reasoning trace it writes is the only evidence for judging its answer. The reference-free substitutes each fail differently: self-assessment degrades the answer it was meant to protect, sampling agreement measures stability rather than correctness, and perturbation studies read the expected answer off a human-written template, grading a model rather than a trace. We ask how far a single trace can be verified with no reference solution, no judge model and no weight update, and find, for a frozen LLaMA-2-7B-chat on GSM8K, that detection is not what limits such a pipeline. Checking a trace against itself reaches an AUROC of 0.741 and stops there for a structural reason: two thirds of wrong traces state no false equation, having executed a mistaken plan correctly, and on wrong-plan failures the detector flags a wrong trace less often than a right one. A candidate-derived metamorphic probe exposes many of these failures: we abstract the trace into a program over the question's quantities, perturb one quantity, execute the program, and ask the model the rewritten question once, so every trace supplies its own test. Valid perturbations exist for 937 of 1,319 test questions (71.0%); among the 847 that also have a parseable first trace, supported traces are correct 60.6% of the time against a 31.6% base rate, although the probe also refutes 45.5% of correct traces. No tested policy yields a statistically significant improvement in accuracy. A flag earns its retry only when detector precision exceeds D/(R+D), where R and D are the rates at which a retry repairs a wrong trace and damages a correct one; our repair rate is so low that, at the same retry budget, even a perfect detector would recover an estimated 66 of 1,319 questions. Repair, not detection, is the open problem.

</details>


### [200] [A Consolidated Deployment Edition of a Microservice Core-Banking Platform: Composing Services by Reference into Three Hosts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30212)
*Tomisin Fagbola*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文考察一个多租户 .NET 核心银行平台的第二种部署形态：将 5 个 API 服务按项目引用合成为一个 API 宿主，另配消费者宿主与后台宿主，与原有 9 个 AWS ECS Fargate 任务的微服务版并行构建、对比测试。在模拟的 AWS 部署中，合成版暴露全部 844 个操作，47 个金融负载用例与 231 个读探针中结果一致（1 处差异归于模拟负载均衡器），读吞吐为 2.3 倍、内存占用不足一半，服务任务计算成本估算低 11–24%；代价是故障域扩大（一个 API 宿主崩溃即全部模块下线），16 个注入故障中仍有 1 个未被检出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微服务带来独立部署与伸缩能力，但每个已部署服务都要预留计算资源并增加运维负担。作者希望在不改动源码仓库、不破坏行为一致性的前提下，探索把多个 API 服务合并部署以减少资源占用与运维成本，并定量评估这一取舍（成本/性能收益 vs. 故障域与可观测性代价）。

Method: 同一提交同时构建两个版本：原版为 9 个 ECS Fargate 任务；新版通过项目引用把 5 个 API 服务组合进一个 API 宿主，另有 consumer host 与 background host，服务代码仍留在原仓库。论文描述了组合机制、模块清单、启动检查、请求处理与配置优先级，并在镜像 AWS 拓扑、任务规格和配置的模拟环境中比较两版：844 个操作暴露性验证、47 个金融负载用例与账本比对、5 类主体共 231 个读探针、11 个跨租户与写授权用例、吞吐与内存测量、按牌价估算的计算成本，以及 16 个注入故障的检出率分析。

Result: 合成版暴露全部 844 个声明操作；47 个金融负载用例观测结果与账本完全一致；读探针 231 个中 230 个一致（差异归于模拟负载均衡器）；11 个跨租户/写授权用例均符合预期。性能上读吞吐约为 2.3 倍、内存不足一半，服务任务计算成本估算低 11–24%（不含共享网关、负载均衡、数据存储等）。风险方面故障域扩大：API 宿主崩溃会使 5 个模块同时离线；16 个注入故障中启动/运行检查检出 10 个，行为测试补充检出 5 个，1 个漏检。

Conclusion: 对于该平台，模块化单体式的部署合并能在保持功能与安全行为一致的同时显著降低计算资源与成本，是可落地的第三种部署形态；但需接受更大的故障域和对检测机制的更高要求（检查+行为测试仍可能漏检）。结论仅限单一平台且在模拟环境（复刻拓扑、任务规模与配置）中得出，并非生产 AWS 实测，需在生产环境进一步验证。

Abstract: Microservices give teams independent deployment and scaling, but each deployed service also reserves compute and adds operational work. This paper examines a second deployment edition of a multi-tenant .NET core-banking platform. The existing edition runs as nine AWS ECS Fargate tasks; the alternative composes the five API services by project reference into one API host, alongside a consumer host and a background host. The service code remains in its original repositories, and both editions continue to be built from the same commits. We describe the composition mechanism, module manifest, start-up checks, request handling and configuration precedence, then compare the editions in an emulation of the AWS deployment. The composed edition exposes all 844 declared operations. Across 47 financial workload cases, both editions produced the same observed outcomes and matching ledgers. In read probes across five principal types, 230 of 231 endpoint results matched; the remaining difference was associated with the emulated load balancer. Eleven cross-tenant and write-authorisation cases also produced the expected outcomes in both editions. In the emulation, the composed edition delivered 2.3 times the read throughput and used less than half the memory. Estimated service-task compute at list prices was 11-24% lower, excluding the shared gateway, load balancer, data stores and other operating costs. The consolidation also enlarges the failure domain: one API-host crash takes all five modules offline. Of 16 injected faults, the edition's checks detected 10, behavioural tests detected five additional faults, and one fault escaped both. These findings concern one platform and an emulated deployment that mirrors its topology, task sizes and configuration; they are not production-AWS measurements.

</details>


### [201] [JANUS: Agentic Cross-Language Fuzzing Harness Generation for Android Native Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30218)
*Xiangyu Zhang,Yucheng Su,Lingling Fan,Yinan Li,Sen Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: JANUS 是首个面向 Android 原生库的"智能体式"跨语言 JNI 感知模糊测试用例生成方法，通过迭代解析显式/隐式跨语言调用依赖并自底向上递归构造跨语言参数对象，自动合成高质量 fuzzing harness。在 44 个真实应用（21,386 个 JNI 方法）上生成的合法 harness 数量为 SOTA 工具的 5.9 倍以上（6,094 个），并在五大厂商预装应用中发现 6 个此前未知的闭源原生库漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Android 应用大量通过 JNI 桥接 Java/Kotlin 与 C/C++，把内存安全的 Android Runtime 暴露给不安全的原生代码，形成常被利用的攻击面。模糊测试虽有效，但现有 harness 生成工具难以忠实还原闭源库的跨语言 API 使用：(i) 跨 JNI 边界的精确程序分析难以扩展，轻量近似又会漏掉关键调用模式；(ii) 无人解决 JNI 方法所需的复杂复合对象构造问题。

Method: 提出 JANUS，采用自主智能体工作流：迭代解析显式与隐式的跨语言调用依赖，以恢复应用特定的运行时上下文；自底向上递归组装跨语言参数对象；以减少对手工启发式规则的依赖，从闭源原生库中挖掘隐含的 API 使用知识。

Result: 在 44 个流行真实应用（如 Google、YouTube Music，覆盖 21,386 个 JNI 方法）上，JANUS 生成 6,094 个合法 harness，是 SOTA 自动工具数量的 5.9 倍以上；在小米、vivo、三星等五家主流厂商的预装应用中，额外发现 6 个此前未知的闭源原生库漏洞。

Conclusion: 智能体式、面向跨语言依赖解析与复合对象构造的 harness 合成，能显著提升 Android 原生库模糊测试的可行性与漏洞发现能力，优于依赖启发式或轻量近似的现有方案。

Abstract: Modern Android apps extensively rely on native libraries, bridging Java/Kotlin and C/C++ through the Java Native Interface (JNI). This cross-language interoperation, however, exposes the memory-safe Android Runtime to the unsafe C/C++ world, creating an attack surface that has been repeatedly exploited for full device compromise. While fuzzing is a proven technique for vetting native libraries, state-of-the-art harness generation tools struggle to faithfully capture closed-source cross-language API usage: (i) precise program analysis across the JNI boundary does not scale, whereas lightweight approximations miss critical invocation patterns; and (ii) none tackles the construction of complex composite objects consumed by JNI methods.
  In this paper, we propose JANUS, the first agentic approach to synthesizing cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harnesses for Android native libraries. JANUS iteratively resolves both explicit and implicit cross-language call dependencies to recover app-specific runtime context, and recursively assembles cross-language argument objects in a bottom-up manner. JANUS leverages an autonomous agentic workflow to reduce reliance on hand-crafted heuristics, capturing the vast landscape of hidden API usage knowledge embedded in closed-source native libraries. Evaluation on 44 popular real-world apps (such as Google and YouTube Music, covering 21,386 JNI methods total) shows that JANUS produces over 5.9 times as many valid harnesses (6,094) as state-of-the-art automatic harnessing tools. On pre-installed apps from five mainstream Android vendors (e.g., Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung), JANUS further uncovers 6 previously unknown vulnerabilities in closed-source native libraries.

</details>


### [202] [Agentic Architecture of Information Systems. The AAM/5C Model: A Reference Model for Distributed Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30221)
*Laurent Goujon*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本书提出概念性参考模型 AAM/5C（五项能力×七层），在单一授权规则 R-AUT 下用"提议—决策—执行"分离来治理大规模自主系统，声明十条假设中两条由构造成立、其余可反驳，并给出验证计划，但无实证结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型组织面临"认知复杂度墙"：当组件达数百个且相互交互时，维护依赖图谱并按事故节奏响应已超出人类团队的能力，因此需要一个在结构上把提议、决策与执行分离的治理参考模型。

Method: 概念性/规范性方法。将 Capture、Comprehend、Choose、Coordinate、Control 五项能力实例化于 L1–L7 七个逻辑层；以 R-AUT 单一授权规则约束流程：L4 概率规划器提议，L6 治理层依据签名策略决策并记录签名评估证明，L5 安全层签发与该证明绑定的短时行动令牌，策略执行点在目标层落实行动前校验两者。辅以 Rego 授权策略、部分 TLA+ 的对等共识规范，并预先固定可反驳假设的检验协议。

Result: 无实证结果。在显式保证契约下，H7a、H8a 两条分析性陈述由构造成立；其余假设（含日志完备性 H7b、执行点不可绕过 H8b）均为可反驳，且反驳协议在测量前即已确定。另给出与自主计算、多智能体系统、企业架构及 MCP/A2A 等智能体协议的定位比较与带量化里程碑的验证计划。

Conclusion: 贡献是一个规范性参考模型：在单一授权规则下整合既有机制，并新增三个待验证构造——分布式自主循环中的 Validation 步骤、短时权限面（ephemeral authority surface）、认知依赖平面（cognitive dependency plane）。其价值在于可反驳性与可验证性设计，而非已验证的效能。

Abstract: Large organizations increasingly face what this book calls the cognitive complexity wall: at the scale of hundreds of interacting components, maintaining the dependency map and reacting at the pace of incidents exceeds what a human team can deliver. This conceptual volume proposes AAM/5C, in which five capabilities (Capture, Comprehend, Choose, Coordinate, Control) are instantiated across seven logical layers, L1 to L7. A single authorization rule, R-AUT, separates who proposes, who decides and who executes: a probabilistic planner (L4) proposes; a governance layer (L6) decides under signed policies and records its verdict in a signed evaluation proof; a security layer (L5) issues a short-lived act token bound to that proof; a policy enforcement point verifies both before the target layer materializes the act. Under an explicit guarantee contract, two analytical statements (H7a, H8a) hold by construction. The other statements of its ten hypotheses (H1 to H10), including log completeness (H7b) and non-bypass of the enforcement point (H8b), are refutable, and the protocol that could refute them is fixed before any measurement. The contribution of the book is a prescriptive reference model that articulates, under this single authorization rule, known mechanisms and adds three constructs, all to be validated: the Validation step of the Distributed Autonomy Loop, the ephemeral authority surface and the cognitive dependency plane. The book positions them against autonomic computing, multi-agent systems, enterprise architecture and agent protocols (MCP, A2A), gives an authorization policy in Rego and a partial TLA+ specification of peer consensus, and sets out a validation program with quantified milestones. It reports no empirical results. This English edition is a translation of the French original, produced with the assistance of AI tools and validated by the author.

</details>


### [203] [The Customer Is the Builder: How AI Coding Agents Are Rewriting the Economics of Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30307)
*Ripon Chandra Malo,Zimeng Yu,Tong Qiu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 随着AI编程智能体能力快速提升（基准任务长度约每129天翻倍），组织"自建"替代"采购"软件的边界正在扩展；575个潜在开源替代品、Craft套件12天产出12个应用仓库，且32%的组织受访者称曾因可用编码智能体自建而放弃至少一次软件采购，但整体市场证据仍混合。作者提出"软件替代前沿"概念，并警告个体购买决策可能先于广泛采购转向发生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体可能改变组织"买软件还是自建功能"的抉择。既有研究缺乏对"客户能以可接受标准自建并维护、且成本低于购买"这一能力边界的系统刻画，也缺少能力增长与市场变化指标之间的对照分析，因此作者希望刻画能力与市场之间的错配风险。

Method: 提出"软件替代前沿"定义；用公开数据比较AI编码能力增长（50%成功率的基准任务时长、人类工作时间计量）与市场变化指标；广泛检索识别575个针对选定商业产品的潜在开源替代；以Craft套件进行12天公开开发实证（12个应用仓库）；开展组织调查获取自建替代采购的自报数据；结合基准外推与可观测市场检验（投资份额、商业安装量）。

Result: 2023年以来，领先智能体在50%成功率下的基准任务时长约每129天翻倍；识别出575个潜在开源替代品（部分功能匹配仍需独立验证）；Craft套件12.0天产出12个应用仓库，但完整性可靠性未经验证；市场证据混合——购买软件的美资份额上升、已追踪商业安装量增长，但32%的组织受访者报告曾放弃至少一次采购。

Conclusion: 客户的"自建能力"可能先影响个体购买决策，再显现为广泛的采购转向，因此需要警惕这种滞后错配。自报数据不足以确定实际被替代的支出或产出工具的可靠性，基准外推也非对客户切换的预测，结论应视为预警而非预测。

Abstract: AI coding agents could change whether organizations buy software or build the functionality they need. We focus on organizations and professional buyers whose domain knowledge can help them specify and evaluate tools for their work. We define the software substitution frontier as the functions customers could build and maintain at an acceptable standard for less than buying them. Using public data, we compare growing capacity to build with indicators of market change. Since 2023, the length of benchmark tasks that leading agents can complete at 50 percent success, measured in human working time, has doubled about every 129 days. A broad search identified 575 potential open-source alternatives to selected commercial products, although some functional matches still require independent validation. The Craft suite produced 12 application repositories over 12.0 days of public development, but these remain early versions with unverified completeness and reliability. Market evidence is mixed: purchased software gained US investment share and tracked commercial installations grew. Yet 32 percent of respondents to an organizational survey reported forgoing at least one software purchase because their organization could build the functionality with coding agents. These self-reports do not establish the spending displaced or the reliability of the resulting tools. The gap motivates a warning: customers' capacity to build could affect individual buying decisions before a broad purchasing shift becomes visible. We examine this possibility using benchmark projections and observable market tests. The projections are an extrapolation, not a forecast of customer switching.

</details>


### [204] [TrustedCode: Evaluating Large Language Models for Developing Trusted Code through Automated Program Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30432)
*Muhammad Danial,Muhammad Taimoor Khan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TrustedCode 是一个自动化框架，利用 LLM 将 AI 生成的 Python 代码进行类型检查、翻译为 WhyML 并通过 Why3 后端自动定理证明器进行形式化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约30%的 GitHub Python 代码贡献由 AI 生成，而这类代码不可靠。形式化验证可建立可信度，但现有工具主要支持 Java/C，Python 支持很少，且撰写形式规范和验证正确性难度大。

Method: 使用 LLM 完成三步：(i) 对 Python 代码进行类型检查；(ii) 通过 Why3 框架翻译为 WhyML；(iii) 用 Why3 后端自动定理证明器对照形式规范验证。通过 LangGraph 集成思维链提示，识别并弥补 LLM 在规范生成与证明中的局限。

Result: 在10个不同复杂度的 Python 程序上评估。错误分析显示：50% 源于领域知识缺口，30% 源于语法不准确，其余20% 为语义和类型相关问题。

Conclusion: 研究凸显了针对 Python 的 LLM 引导形式化验证工作流需进行有针对性的改进。TrustedCode 已开源（github.com/mtaimoorkhan/TrustedCode），并提供视频演示。

Abstract: Recent reports, such as "Who is using AI to code?", indicate that approximately 30\% of Python code contributions to GitHub are AI-generated. Given the inherent unreliability of this code, formal verification emerges as a promising approach to establish trust in software correctness. Although leveraging large language models (LLMs) for formal verification has garnered increasing attention, practical adoption remains limited due to the challenges in writing formal specifications and verifying program correctness against them. Existing tools predominantly support verification for languages such as Java and C, with minimal support for Python. We present TrustedCode, an automated framework for verifying AI-generated Python code. TrustedCode uses LLMs to (i) type-check Python code, (ii) translate it into WhyML via the Why3 framework, and (iii) verify it against formal specifications using Why3 back-end automated theorem provers. Our method integrates chain-of-thought prompting through LangGraph to identify and address LLM limitations in specification generation and proving the specified programs. To evaluate TrustedCode, we conducted experiments on ten Python programs of varying complexity. Our analysis reveals that 50\% of the observed errors stem from domain knowledge gaps, 30\% from syntactic inaccuracies, and the remaining 20\% from semantic and type-related issues. These findings underscore the importance of targeted improvements in LLM-guided formal verification workflows for Python. TrustedCode is an open source tool available at: \href{github.com/mtaimoorkhan/TrustedCode}{github.com/mtaimoorkhan/TrustedCode}. The video demonstration is available at: \href{youtu.be/Nr5I2g8ec-s}{youtu.be/Nr5I2g8ec-s}

</details>


### [205] [Stale Instruction Files Override the Code in Coding Agents: A One-Sentence Fix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30571)
*Xiaonan Xu,Wenjing Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 编码智能体倾向盲从陈旧的指令文件（如 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md）而忽视与之冲突的现有代码；在用户级指令文件中加入一句"代码优先"即可将遵循代码的比例从4.2%提升至91.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体即使发现指令文件与代码冲突，仍会服从指令文件，甚至改写可运行的代码导致测试失败，这一行为缺乏量化研究，作者希望测量并寻找简单可行的纠正方法。

Method: 构建40个Python项目，每个项目指令文件要求一种约定而现有代码使用另一种（如用print而非logging）；让Claude Code和Codex CLI在有无"代码优先"语句两种条件下各添加功能，共320次运行。

Result: 无语句时90.1%的选择遵循陈旧文件；Claude Code在80次中79次指出冲突却仍服从；Codex CLI在80次中20次改写现有代码，其中17次导致测试失败。加上语后遵循代码比例由4.2%升至91.4%，停止改写，测试通过率由89.4%升至100%。

Conclusion: 作者将其归因于两种信息的传递形式：指令文件作为"指令"进入模型，代码作为"工具输出"进入，而模型被训练为对后者赋予更低权重。用户现可手动添加该语句，智能体与模型厂商也可将同样规则内置到产品中。

Abstract: Purpose: Coding agents follow a project's instruction file, such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, even when it disagrees with the existing code and even when they notice the disagreement. We measure this behaviour and test whether one sentence in the user's own instruction file makes agents follow the code instead.
  Methods: We built 40 Python projects in which the instruction file asks for one convention while the existing code uses another, for example print instead of logging. Claude Code and Codex CLI added a feature to each project, with and without a sentence in the user-level instruction file that gives the existing code precedence, in 320 runs.
  Results: Without the sentence, 90.1% of the agents' choices followed the stale file. Claude Code pointed out the conflict in 79 of 80 runs and still followed the file. Codex CLI rewrote the existing code to match the file in 20 of 80 runs, and the project's own tests then failed in 17 of them. The sentence raised the share of choices that follow the code from 4.2% to 91.4%, stopped the rewrites and raised the test pass rate from 89.4% to 100%.
  Conclusion: We attribute the behaviour to how agents receive the two sources: the instruction file reaches the model as an instruction and the code as tool output, which models are trained to rank lower. Users can add the sentence today, and makers of agents and models can build the same rule into their products.

</details>


### [206] [From Tokens to Credits to Outcomes: Pricing AI Across Models, Applications, and Cloud Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30701)
*Pratik Gupta*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对2023–2026年AI软件定价做可复现研究，编码公开定价页与文档，提出定价原语分类法，并给出自动化计费平台需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SaaS按席位定价，因边际服务成本近零；而模型推理边际成本非零且用量跨客户差数量级，催生了预付额度、按量计费、席位+用量混合、成果定价等新模式，但这些定价模型尚未被系统刻画。

Method: 对公开定价产物（定价页与文档）开展可复现研究，覆盖三个队列：Forbes AI 50（2026）全体作为AI原生核心样本、按明示规则纳入的销售AI服务的云平台、以及冻结的9个独特设计目的性样本；对每个产品的定价原语与额度机制进行编码，并标注日期与一手来源，构建公开数据集。

Result: 贡献三项：(1) 带日期一手来源、随论文公开的数据集；(2) 定价原语分类法及各队列分布；(3) 对自动化可配置计费平台的经验性需求（额度账本状态、成果定价归因流水线、高频定价变更的配置支持）。AI原生公司中"订阅+用量配额"为最主要可观察模式（占可观察AI原生行55%，敏感性分析45–61%）；52个AI原生行中23个未公布定价。

Conclusion: 混合产品宜理解为"包装锚点+配额机制+计费单元"的组合，而非互斥类别；所有材料均公开，作者雇主被排除在样本外。

Abstract: Between 2023 and 2026, AI changed how software is priced. Traditional SaaS charged per seat because serving one more user cost almost nothing. Model inference has non-zero marginal cost, and usage varies by orders of magnitude across customers, producing prepaid credits, metered usage, hybrid seat-plus-usage models, and outcome pricing that supplement, and in rare cases replace, seat-based pricing. These pricing models have not been systematically characterized. This paper presents a reproducible study of public pricing artifacts - pricing pages and documentation - across three cohorts: the full Forbes AI 50 (2026) as the AI-native core sample, cloud platforms selling AI services included by a documented rule, and a frozen purposive cohort of 9 distinctive designs. It contributes (1) a dataset coding each offering's pricing primitive and credit mechanics with dated primary sources, prepared for public release with the paper, (2) a taxonomy of the primitives in use and their distribution across cohorts, and (3) empirically grounded requirements for automated, configurable billing platforms, including ledger state for credits, attribution pipelines for outcome pricing, and configuration support for high pricing-change velocity. Subscription with usage quota is the dominant observable model among AI-native companies (55% of observable AI-native rows; 45-61% under sensitivity analysis of hybrid boundary cases). 23 of the 52 AI-native rows publish no pricing. Hybrid products are better understood as compositions of packaging anchor, allowance mechanism, and billable unit than as mutually exclusive categories. All artifacts are public; my employer is excluded from the sample.

</details>


### [207] [From Natural Language to Verified C: Verification-Guided Generation with ACSL Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30725)
*Zian Wang,Qin Li,Weisong Sun,Haibin Cai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VeriGen-C 是一个面向形式化验证的框架，从自然语言需求联合合成 C 程序与 ACSL 规范，在三个基准上将"通过验证且符合需求"的解决方案比例从 5.5%→44.5%、44.3%→80.0%、6.5%→58.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 代码生成需要可机器检查的正确性证据，但现有方法将代码与规范独立生成：导致缺少证明锚点、程序结构不利于自动推理、代码状态与规范需求不一致，即使验证通过也可能只是弱规范，遗漏关键行为。

Method: 提出 VeriGen-C，将实现与规范作为统一的"验证优化"工件协同设计。代码生成与修复受约束以暴露证明相关状态、简化控制流以利演绎验证、消除阻碍自动证明搜索的实现模式；规范生成与精炼同样受约束，以减少验证超时并保证与用户需求对齐。

Result: 在 HumanEval-X、FM-Bench、LiveCodeBench Lite 上，相较于接口兼容基线，"验证通过且需求对齐"的比例分别从 5.5% 提升到 44.5%、44.3% 到 80.0%、6.5% 到 58.7%。

Conclusion: 联合且有约束地协同合成代码与规范，能显著提升自动形式化验证的成功率与需求覆盖度，表明"为验证而设计"的生成范式优于分别独立生成代码和规范。

Abstract: AI-assisted code generation amplifies the demand for automated formal verification. Generated programs must not only be executable but also accompanied by machine-checkable evidence of correctness. Existing approaches can synthesize functionally plausible code or plausible-looking specifications from natural-language prompts; however, they do not explicitly co-design the implementation and specification as a unified artifact optimized for verification. Consequently, automated verifiers often fail to discharge proof obligations. Typical failure modes include missing or implicit proof anchors, program structures that are hostile to automated reasoning, and inconsistencies between code-level state and specification-level requirement facts arising from the independent generation of code and specifications. Even when verification succeeds, it may only establish weak specifications that omit requirement-critical behavior. This paper introduces VeriGen-C, a formal-verification-friendly framework for the joint synthesis of C programs and ACSL specifications from natural-language requirements. Code generation and repair are constrained to expose proof-relevant state, to streamline control flow for deductive verification, and to eliminate implementation patterns that hinder automated proof search. Specification generation and refinement are similarly constrained to mitigate verification timeouts and to ensure alignment with the user requirements. Empirical evaluations on HumanEval-X, FM-Bench, and LiveCodeBench Lite demonstrate that VeriGen-C substantially improves the rate of verified and requirement-aligned solutions relative to an interface-compatible baseline, from 5.5% to 44.5%, from 44.3% to 80.0%, and from 6.5% to 58.7%, respectively.

</details>


### [208] [VLTest: Finding Joint Image-Text Failures in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30794)
*Bin Duan,Jintao Lin,Guowei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VLTest是一个黑盒视觉语言模型测试方法，通过编辑VQGAN潜码生成图像变体、重写-扩展-剪枝生成文本变体，先用VLM判定器过滤可能改变期望答案的变体，再单独测试每个变体后才测组合，使每个联合失败都有四格匹配单元；在三任务八模型（含两个商用API模型）上，判定器确认81.7%候选，对人类标签精确率88.8%–94.6%，四格确认拒绝22.5%联合候选，同等预算下确认失败数为基础方法的1.8–2.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs被广泛嵌入软件系统，但测试困难：变异图像或文本任一方都可能改变期望答案，故输出变化本身不等于失败；部分失败仅在双输入同时变异时出现，需单独测试各变异才能归因于组合。

Method: 黑盒VLM测试：(1) 通过编辑VQGAN潜码生成图像变体，用重写-扩展-剪枝流水线生成文本变体；(2) 过滤可能改变期望答案的变体；(3) 先单独测试每个变体，再测组合，使每个联合失败具备四格匹配单元；(4) 由VLM判定器在确认输入仍保持期望答案后才判定失败。

Result: 三个任务、八个VLM（含两个商用API模型）上，判定器确认81.7%候选，对人类标签精确率88.8%–94.6%；四格确认拒绝22.5%联合候选；同等预算下VLTest生成器找到的确认失败数为SINVAD与TextFooler的1.8–2.5倍；联合测试每1000次调用发现91–197个已归因联合失败，为相同配对应用于基线变体的1.3倍。

Conclusion: 通过变体过滤、单变异先行测试与VLM判定器确认，VLTest能有效区分真实失败与期望答案变化，显著提升联合失败归因与确认失败发现效率。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly embedded in software systems. Testing them raises two problems. Mutating either input can change the expected answer, so an output change is not by itself a failure. Some failures appear only when both inputs are mutated; attributing them to the combination requires testing each mutation alone. We present VLTest, a black-box VLM testing approach. It generates image variants by editing VQGAN latent codes and text variants with a rewrite-expand-prune pipeline, filters variants likely to change the expected answer, and tests each variant alone before testing combinations, so every joint failure has four matched cells. A VLM judge confirms a failure only after checking that the input keeps the expected answer. On three tasks with eight VLMs, including two commercial API models, the oracle confirms 81.7% of the candidates, with 88.8% to 94.6% precision against human labels, and four-cell confirmation rejects 22.5% of joint candidates. Under the same budget, VLTest's generators find 1.8 to 2.5 times as many confirmed failures as SINVAD and TextFooler, and its joint tests find 91 to 197 attributed joint failures per 1,000 joint calls, 1.3 times as many as the same pairing applied to the baselines' variants.

</details>


### [209] [What Ethereum Developers Ask For, and Whether They Get It: Ten Years of Ethereum Stack Exchange](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30829)
*Tamer Abdelaziz*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文完整分析了2016–2025年间Ethereum Stack Exchange的54,637个提问，用基于提示的主题流水线和多模型委员会标注（准确率87.9%–93.5%），发现需求集中于合约编写/部署/调试及工具链，而"供给"（获答与采纳率）持续下滑，且下滑主要由提问者身份（新手化）而非主题构成解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以太坊社区通常靠问卷和访谈了解开发者困难，但这只记录被问到的话题；ESE则记录了开发者自发提出的求助及是否被解决，因此可以无采样误差地刻画真实支持需求与供给缺口。

Method: 抓取2016年1月至2025年12月全部ESE提问；用种子化八主题、可扩展的提示式主题流水线标注（共22主题）；由三家模型组成委员会审查标签，并对所有争议样本人工裁决以评估准确率；随后用五种估计量衡量答覆率与采纳率随时间的变化，并通过固定早期主题构成、分解提问者声誉/新人比例等方式归因。

Result: 需求集中于合约编写、部署与调试，工具链为第二大且增长中的主题，安全、共识、扩容较少。获答率下降9.5–18.6个百分点，已答问题中采纳率下降16.2–24.5个百分点；固定主题构成后降幅仅从9.40变到9.32，说明主题不解释下滑。提问者身份影响更大：采纳率从低声誉(<10)的19.8%到高声誉(≥10k)的66.8%，跨47个百分点，主题间仅17；新手比例上升最多解释59%的采纳率下降。

Conclusion: ESE的支持缺口集中在工具链领域和新手群体；供给削弱更多源于"谁来问"而非"问什么"，社区应针对工具链与新手提问者设计支持措施。

Abstract: The Ethereum community learns where developers struggle through surveys and interviews, which record what developers say when asked about a chosen theme. Ethereum Stack Exchange (ESE) records what they ask for unprompted, and whether anyone resolves it. We study every question posted to ESE from Jan 2016 to Dec 2025, 54,637 in all, and label each with a prompt-based topic pipeline seeded with eight Ethereum-specific topics and open to new ones (22 topics in all). A three-provider committee of language models screens the labels, and manual adjudication of every disputed case puts their accuracy at 87.9 to 93.5%. Because the corpus is the complete record, no rate carries sampling error. We ask what developers ask for help with, whether the venue still resolves it, and, where it does not, whether the questions changed or their resolution did.
  Demand is concentrated on writing, deploying, and debugging contracts; the toolchain is the second-largest topic and growing, while security, consensus, and scaling are thin. Supply has weakened, and unevenly: answers still arrive, closure falls further. Across five estimators of the decade, the share of questions drawing any answer fell by 9.5 to 18.6 percentage points, but among answered questions the share reaching an accepted answer fell by 16.2 to 24.5. Rebuilding the later acceptance rate at the earlier topic mix moves the fall only from 9.40 to 9.32 points, so the topic mix does not explain it. Who asks separates outcomes far more sharply than what is asked: acceptance runs from 19.8% for askers below 10 reputation to 66.8% at 10k and above, a 47- point spread with a gradient in every year, against 17 across topics, and a shift toward newer askers accounts for up to 59% of the acceptance fall. The largest of seven properties an asker controls accompanies 5 points. The record places the support gap in the toolchain and among newcomers.

</details>


### [210] [Separate Field Scoring Protects Unused Tools When Agents Pool Tool-Use Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30867)
*Abhijit Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文研究在共享工具库中汇集各代理的工具使用示例对工具检索的影响，并区分"无使用记录的留出工具"和其余工具分别报告。作者提出将使用评分作为独立字段的方法SYNAPSE，发现添加使用示例会提升已用工具的Hit@5，却损害留出工具；而该保护效应主要源于额外条目本身而非使用内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多代理从同一共享工具目录调用工具，可以汇集各自"哪个工具服务哪类请求"的学习成果。但汇集使用示例究竟对工具检索有何影响、尤其是否会挤占无使用记录的留出工具，缺少量化分析。

Method: 在三个工具目录、两种嵌入器上实验：将使用示例作为额外条目加入索引，对比已用工具与留出工具的Hit@5。提出SYNAPSE，把使用评分作为独立字段打分。控制实验包括用其他工具文本填充等长条目、常数分数偏移、用其他工具使用替换，以及将使用记录拆分给十个模拟代理测试汇集效应。

Result: 添加使用示例提升已用工具Hit@5，却在三个目录中的两个及两种嵌入器下大幅降低留出工具Hit@5。等长异工具文本同样降低约同等幅度但几乎无增益。在StableToolBench上SYNAPSE留出工具Hit@5达0.785，优于预留槽位的路由器的0.683，且在全部三个目录两种嵌入器下领先。常数偏移在多数设置下给出相近留出Hit@5。TOUCAN（两种嵌入器）和ToolRet（一种）上路由器在标注查询上保留更多增益。十代理拆分显示汇集收益与单代理相同记录完全一致。

Conclusion: 汇集使用示例对已用工具有益但损害留出工具；留出保护来自额外条目或偏移而非使用内容本身，而已用增益需使用内容对应正确工具。路由器与SYNAPSE孰优取决于工作负载，汇集在多代理下与单代理等效。

Abstract: Agents that call tools from a shared catalog can pool what they learn about which tool serves which request. We measure what pooled usage examples do to tool retrieval, reporting separately the held-out tools, for which no agent has usage, and all other tools. Adding usage examples to the index as extra entries for used tools raises Hit@5 (whether a gold tool is in the top five) for those tools and lowers it for held-out tools, by a large margin on two of three catalogs and with both embedders we tested. Giving used tools the same number of equally long entries filled with other tools' text lowers held-out Hit@5 about as much, but gives little or none of the gain. We call our method of scoring usage as its own field SYNAPSE. On StableToolBench, the held-out gold tool appears in its top five more often than with a router that reserves slots for usage (0.785 against 0.683), and this held-out lead holds on all three catalogs with both embedders. This protection persisted when we replaced each tool's usage with other tools' text, and a constant score offset for tools with usage gives similar held-out Hit@5 in most settings. The gain for tools with usage, in contrast, needs usage about the right tool. The router keeps more of the gain on labeled queries on TOUCAN with both embedders and on ToolRet with one, so the better choice depends on the workload. Splitting the usage among ten simulated agents shows that pooling helps exactly as much as giving one agent the same records.

</details>


### [211] [ATLAS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Lifting Binary to Canonical Compiler IR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30877)
*Xiaoao Zhu,Ni Zhang,Jie Ren,Zhiqiang Li,Jie Zheng,Zhanyong Tang,Zheng Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ATLAS 是一个多智能体框架，从优化后的 stripped 二进制反汇编中重建形式上有效、规范的 LLVM IR，在多项指标上超越七个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源码不可得时，将优化后的二进制提升到规范的前优化 LLVM IR 对下游安全分析与遗留软件迁移很关键；但激进的编译器优化会重写控制/数据流、删除结构元数据、引入类型擦除的底层惯用法，导致现有 lifter 产出畸形或语义偏离的 IR。

Method: ATLAS 结合两类机制：(i) 结构感知的区域级检索，用伪探针归因将优化指令对齐到规范 IR 范例；(ii) 协作式精化循环弥合概率生成与确定性编译器约束之间的差距。具体由 Lift 智能体在检索范例条件下生成初稿 IR，Advisor 智能体解读 LLVM verifier/编译诊断与静态检查并提出局部修复，Validation 智能体应用修改、重跑工具链验证及运行时检查并回传诊断；循环迭代至 IR 通过验证且行为一致或达预算上限。

Result: 在 HumanEval-Decompile 与 MBPP 上，跨 ARM、x86-64、RISC-V 二进制超过七个基线，取得 91.8% 可重执行率与 89.4% CFG 相似度；在指针流精度和下游可分析性上亦优于 Binary→C→IR 流程。

Conclusion: 通过恢复良构、以机器为中心的表征，ATLAS 支持实用的跨 ISA 重编译与可验证的纯二进制迁移工作流。

Abstract: Lifting stripped, heavily optimized binaries to a canonical, pre-optimization LLVM intermediate representation (IR) is essential for downstream security analysis and legacy software migration when source code is unavailable. However, aggressive compiler optimizations rewrite control and data flow, remove structural metadata, and introduce type-erased low-level idioms, causing current lifters to produce malformed or semantically divergent IR. We present ATLAS, a multi-agent framework designed to reconstruct formally valid and canonical LLVM IR from optimized disassembly.ATLAS combines (i) Structure-aware, region-level retrieval, which utilizes pseudo-probe attribution to align optimized instructions with canonical IR exemplars, and (ii) a collaborative refinement loop that closes the gap between probabilistic generation and deterministic compiler constraints. Concretely, a Lift agent generates an initial IR draft conditioned on retrieved exemplars, an Advisor agent interprets LLVM verifier/compilation diagnostics and static checks to propose localized repair actions, and a Validation agent applies the edits, re-runs toolchain verification and (when available) runtime checks, and feeds the resulting diagnostics back to the Advisor. The agents iterate until the IR is verifier-clean and behaviorally consistent, or a budget limit is reached. On HumanEval-Decompile and MBPP, ATLAS outperforms seven baselines on lifting LLVM IR, achieving 91.8% re-executability and 89.4% CFG similarity across ARM, x86-64, and RISC-V binaries. Moreover, our evaluation demonstrates that ATLAS also outperforms the Binary to C to IR pipelines in pointer-flow precision and downstream analyzability. By recovering a well-formed, machine-centric representation, ATLAS enables practical cross-ISA recompilation and verifiable binary-only migration workflows.

</details>


### [212] [When Code Gets Cheap, Evaluation Gets Scarce: An Experience Report on AI-Assisted Agile Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30916)
*Barbara Weber,Olaf Zimmermann,Marco Franceschetti*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 单开发者零手写代码，三天构建并部署合规关键的带人工审核的考试评分系统，据此论证AI使"写代码"变得充裕、而"可靠评估"成为新的瓶颈约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流叙事只强调编码助手"加速代码生产"，却止步于此，忽视了它对软件工程稀缺资源结构的改变。作者希望用一次端到端的真实构建与部署经验，说明AI真正改变的是"什么变得稀缺"。

Method: 以单个开发者（同时是终端用户与领域专家）的身份，用AI助手完成一个合规关键、人在回路中的考试评分系统的全流程构建；采用带门禁、可追溯的流程（从利益相关者画像到经审计的行为），并在真实环境中部署验证；另以一个第二项目和独立的单专家案例作佐证。

Result: 系统三天建成并可对真实队列评分。多个缺陷通过了测试套件——它们位于被mock的边界（浏览器、LLM API）或仅在真实使用中显现；部署暴露了本地测试遗漏的假设；AI助手在多步任务中绕过流程检查点，直到把检查点变为可强制执行的"门禁"才被约束。局限在于三重身份合一使评估成本最低，故该案例是对"评估稀缺"的严格压力测试。

Conclusion: 提出五项经验：(1) 运行带门禁、可追溯的构建流程；(2) 明确哪些是可知的，其余靠运行中的原型去发现；(3) 在真实环境中验证；(4) 约束AI助手而非仅约束产物；(5) 记录决策及其假设与助手会遗忘的流程状态。第二项目与独立单专家案例呈现相似模式，佐证这一稀缺性转向。

Abstract: Coding assistants are widely reported to speed up code production; most accounts stop there. We report the end-to-end construction and deployment of a compliance-critical, human-in-the-loop exam-grading system, built by a single developer who wrote no code by hand, protected by a gated process from stakeholder persona to audited behavior. The initial system was built in three working days and could grade a real cohort. We draw one claim from this experience: AI changes software engineering less by making programming faster than by changing what is scarce. Writing code becomes abundant. Reliable evaluation-knowing whether a result is correct and meets the actual need-remains necessary at every iteration and becomes the binding constraint. Engineering judgment remains a second scarcity. Several defects passed the test suite: they sat at the boundaries the tests had mocked, the browser and the language-model API, or appeared only in real use. Deployment exposed assumptions that local tests had missed. Moreover, an AI assistant acting across many steps bypassed process checkpoints until we made them enforceable gates. All of this was observed in a triple union: the developer was also the end user and domain expert, making expert judgment immediately available and evaluation as cheap as it can be. This favors the iteration gains, which may shrink where evaluation requires additional people or expertise, but makes the case a hard test for evaluation scarcity: evaluation still constrained progress. We draw five lessons: run a gated, traceable construction process; specify what is knowable and discover the rest against a running prototype; validate in the real environment; gate the assistant, not only the work; record decisions with their assumptions and the process state the assistant forgets. A second project showed similar patterns; an independent single-expert case corroborates the shift.

</details>


### [213] [REGATTA: A Cross-Domain Measurement Framework and Fault-Injection Harness for Enterprise AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30924)
*Luong Tuan Thanh,Abhijit Sanyal*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: REGATTA是一个用于评估企业AI-agent测试套件的测量框架，包含源引用清单、故障语料库和两阶段评分harness，并通过源审计与多项诊断检验其测试规则的可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI-agent评测需要证据：测试套件能否暴露指定故障，以及其参考规则是否可信。现有评测缺乏对测试有效性与规则来源可靠性的系统测量。

Method: 构建三件工具：(1)125项含来源引用的清单，覆盖美越两国五个行业×司法辖区单元；(2)25条故障语料库，分五类；(3)在设计阶段与执行阶段评分套件级故障检测的harness。对三个LLM生成器的180个套件(5,400场景)进行四项测量诊断，并做源审计、当前模型复测与盲法裁定。

Result: 源审计：24项误述现行规则、46项其他引用缺陷、31项仅有非约束/不可识别/不可验证来源、仅24项核实无误；仅被实质标记项经作者复核，24项干净行仅经AI复核。条目覆盖度不一；执行阶段故障画像跨生成器稳定；历史两阶段在66–69%故障–套件对上一致。US保险复测中阶段分歧超过重复执行变异，但阶段一致度.536低于合并机会水平.549，未通过V3下界不等式。盲法裁定支持设计阶段判定协议(κ=.72, 95%区间[.52,.88])；40次当前模型执行探针得κ=.75。

Conclusion: 结果为“工具按所写内容”的表现，而非法律合规结论；阶段判定信度得到支持，但V3一致性下界假设未获满足。工具、审计与可复用代码已公开。

Abstract: Enterprise AI-agent evaluation needs evidence about whether test suites expose specified faults and whether their reference rules are trustworthy. We introduce REGATTA (Regulatory Evaluation of Agents via Two-stage Testing and Assurance), a measurement framework with three instruments. A 125-item source-cited checklist spans five industry-by-jurisdiction cells across the United States and Vietnam. A 25-fault corpus covers five categories, and a harness scores suite-level fault detection at the design and execution stages. We examine four measurement diagnostics on 180 generated suites (5,400 scenarios) from three LLM generators. A source audit finds 24 items misstating the rule in force, 46 additional citation defects, 31 items with only non-binding, unidentifiable, or unverifiable sources, and 24 verified clean. Only initially substance-flagged items received author review; all 24 clean rows received AI review only. Results therefore describe the instruments as written, not legal compliance. Item coverage varies, execution-stage fault profiles are stable across generators, and the historical stages agree on $66$--$69\%$ of fault--suite pairs. A current-model US-insurance retest finds stage disagreement above repeated-execution variation, but stage agreement $.536$ falls below pooled chance $.549$, failing V3's lower inequality. Blind adjudication by one expert supports the design-stage judging protocol ($κ=.72$, 95% interval $[.52,.88]$); 40 current-model execution probes give $κ=.75$. The instruments, audit, and reusable code are released.

</details>


### [214] [Tracing Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning for UML Class Diagram Generation: An Empirical Taxonomy and Mitigation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30946)
*Mojdeh Rahmanian,Foutse Khomh,Ashkan Sami,Yanchao Yu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个面向LLM从需求生成UML类图过程的幻觉分类体系（11个子类型、3个维度），并基于DeepSeek-R1/V4-Pro推理轨迹进行标注分析，发现失败模式随模型而异，且通过提示词约束可将F1平均提升4.0个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多只看最终UML图，忽略了具备推理能力的LLM的中间推理轨迹，无法定位幻觉产生的具体环节，因而难以进行有针对性的缓解。

Method: 提出三维度、11子类型的幻觉分类法：Prompt Faithfulness（需求与推理的偏差）、Code Faithfulness（推理与生成PlantUML代码的不一致）、Reasoning Quality（推理内部问题）。基于60条人工标注的DeepSeek-R1轨迹归纳分类，用双LLM标注流水线扩展到120条轨迹，并在20条DeepSeek-V4-Pro轨迹上检验；另在13个Golden UML ModelSet案例上用三个Qwen3模型做提示词缓解实验。

Result: DeepSeek-R1在两个数据集中均以Code Faithfulness最常见，而DeepSeek-V4-Pro以Prompt Faithfulness为主，提示失败模式与模型相关；推理轨迹长度与幻觉频率无显著单调关系，需求复杂度反而与幻觉频率负相关（尤见于Prompt Faithfulness错误）。加入Prompt Faithfulness与Reasoning Quality约束后汇总平均F1提升4.0个百分点，而事后Code Faithfulness审查无稳定额外收益；关系建模始终得分最低。

Conclusion: 在生成过程中定位幻觉可指导有针对性的提示词缓解，但结论能否推广到DeepSeek与Qwen3之外的模型家族仍待验证。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate UML class diagrams from natural language requirements, but hallucinations may compromise the correctness and completeness of the resulting diagrams. Existing evaluations mostly assess the final diagram, without examining the intermediate traces of reasoning-capable LLMs, which can reveal where these hallucinations arise. We develop an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types organised into three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness (deviations between requirements and reasoning), Code Faithfulness (discrepancies between reasoning and generated PlantUML code), and Reasoning Quality (problems within the reasoning). The taxonomy was derived from 60 manually annotated DeepSeek-R1 traces, applied to 120 further DeepSeek-R1 traces through a dual-LLM annotation pipeline, and examined on 20 DeepSeek-V4-Pro traces. Code Faithfulness was the most frequent dimension for DeepSeek-R1 in both datasets, whereas Prompt Faithfulness dominated for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, suggesting model-dependent failure patterns. In the manually annotated traces, reasoning-trace length showed no significant monotonic association with hallucination frequency, whereas requirement complexity was negatively associated with it, particularly for Prompt Faithfulness errors. In a mitigation experiment on 13 Golden UML ModelSet cases with three Qwen3-based models, adding Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality constraints to the generation prompt raised the pooled mean F1 score by 4.0 percentage points, whereas a post-hoc Code Faithfulness review provided no consistent further benefit. Relationship modelling remained the lowest-scoring element throughout. These results suggest that localising hallucinations within the generation process can inform targeted, prompt-based mitigation. Whether these findings generalise beyond the DeepSeek and Qwen3 model families remains to be tested.

</details>


### [215] [ProductWebBench: Evaluating Website Continuity Beyond Task Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31118)
*Jiajun Wu,Jian Yang,Yaxin Du,Shukai Liu,Linzheng Chai,Tuney Zheng,Wei Zhang,Haitao Yang,Yan Bai,Yihang Lou,Xianglong Liu,Bryan Dai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出ProductWebBench基准，在真实前端仓库上同时评测"目标是否建成"与"网站连续性是否保持"，涵盖320个Change任务和80个长程Build任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前端编码智能体只被评估"目标是否建成"，忽略了真实工程中"站点其余部分必须继续正常工作"的第二重义务（website continuity）。

Method: 在活跃前端仓库上构建基准：每个任务冻结仓库快照、分阶段需求、浏览器证据与确定性检查；模拟用户逐阶段透露需求，先前通过的检查全程保持生效；检查同时跑在未修改仓库上以提供回归的精确来源。

Result: 13个模型共8,737次运行显示两项义务分离：通过全部目标检查的Change运行中28.2%仍出现连续性失败（空白路由、横向溢出、控制台错误），10.8%使已通过的浏览器状态回退；586次双读数运行中18.3%被捕获破坏已验证状态；静态DOM已通过的运行中有29.5%在交互上失败。

Conclusion: 前端智能体评测应将补丁置于其所落地的活系统整体中评分，而非仅看目标是否达成。

Abstract: Frontend coding agents are usually graded on one question: did the requested target get built. Real engineering changes carry a second obligation, because the rest of the site has to keep working. We call that second obligation website continuity, and introduce ProductWebBench, a benchmark that scores both on living frontend repositories: 320 Change tasks over existing code and 80 long-horizon Build tasks. Every task freezes a repository snapshot, staged requirements, browser evidence and deterministic checks before evaluation, and enters only once a reference passes every check and plausible-wrong ones fail. A simulated user reveals the requirements one stage at a time, and every check cleared earlier stays armed for the rest of the run. Across 8,737 runs from 13 models the two come apart: of the Change runs passing every requested-work check, 28.2% still fail a continuity check -- a blank route, horizontal overflow, console errors -- and 10.8% push a browser state they had already passed back to failing. Because the same checks also run on the untouched repository, each regression carries exact provenance, not a post-hoc label: on the 586 runs where both readings exist, 18.3% are caught breaking a verified state. Interaction is a further blind spot, failing in 29.5% of runs whose static DOM already passes. ProductWebBench therefore scores a patch against the living system it lands in, not the target alone.

</details>


### [216] [Beyond Accuracy: Disentangling Decomposition from Typed-State Quality Assurance in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31280)
*Maria Gabriela Alves Zuppardo,Vinicius Cardoso Garcia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文在需求工程任务中做归因研究：比较多智能体LLM流水线的性能增益来自"分工带来的专用提示词"还是"智能体间的类型化契约"，发现F1增益主要来自两调用+专用提示词变体，Pydantic类型化状态仅带来微小差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM流水线常被认为能提升软件工程任务表现，但难以区分增益究竟源自智能体之间的类型化契约（typed contract），还是源自任务分解所允许的专用提示词（specialized prompts）。作者希望厘清这一归因问题。
