Tool descriptions cannot all fit in context, and relevance-based retrievers only rank tools without knowing which are actually needed. Recent work instead leverages proprietary commercial LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to drive a retriever, decomposing the instruction and selecting over retrieved candidates. We show that a small, open model can be trained via reinforcement learning to perform the same functionality. On ToolBench, a Qwen3-8B model post-trained with our recipe outperforms Llama-4-Maverick (402B). In addition, the trained model transfers directly to different retrievers and generalizes to new tool corpora in different domains.

</details>


### [321] [SABLE: Scalable Affine Bayesian Latent-space Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31495)
*Erik Bodin,Lisa Maria Kreusser,Donney Fan,Henry Moss,Geoff Pleiss,Nicolas Durrande*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SABLE：面向高维潜空间（D≫预算）、各向同性分布、有限预算的贝叶斯优化方法，基于贝叶斯仿射代理，将查询分解为span内(EI优化)与span外(标量范数控制)两部分，用有限时域调度设定off-span范数避免欠探索，并通过重压缩到O(M)伪观测控制计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程设计、蛋白质等复杂对象的设计空间具高维结构且目标评估昂贵；生成模型的潜空间可达数千至数万维，使潜维度D远大于评估预算，传统BO难以有效探索，且需避免将搜索限制在学习子空间。

Method: 以贝叶斯仿射代理做预测与采集，将高阶结构视为代理偏差；N次观测后斜率更新维数至多N-1，从而把每次查询分解为至多N维的in-span分量（用EI优化）与由标量范数控制的off-span分量；通过有限时域调度显式规定off-span范数以克服仿射EI隐式选择导致的欠探索；采用重压缩方案归约为O(M)伪观测，重拟合代价O(M²D+M³)。

Result: 在合成基准与潜空间优化任务上实现高样本效率；在大预算下决策时间较基线降低数个数量级，参数推断、预测与采集决策保持在几十毫秒级。

Conclusion: SABLE为高维潜空间有限预算贝叶斯优化提供了高效且可扩展的方案，在不限制搜索子空间的前提下兼顾探索质量与计算效率。

Abstract: Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive. Generative models provide continuous latent representations, but their latent spaces can have thousands to tens of thousands of dimensions, creating a regime where the latent dimension $D$ greatly exceeds the evaluation budget. We introduce SABLE, a Bayesian optimisation method for high-dimensional latent spaces with an isotropic distribution and limited budget. SABLE uses a Bayesian affine surrogate for prediction and acquisition, treating higher-order structure as surrogate discrepancy. After $N$ observations, the slope update has dimension at most $N-1$, yielding a decomposition of each query into an in-span component optimised by expected improvement (EI) in at most $N$ dimensions and an off-span component governed by a scalar norm. We show that the off-span norm implicitly selected by affine EI can lead to underexploration, and SABLE instead prescribes it using a finite-horizon schedule, without restricting search to a learned subspace. A recompression scheme reduces information to $\mathcal O(M)$ pseudo-observations, bounding refitting cost by $\mathcal O(M^2D+M^3)$ while keeping parameter inference, prediction, and acquisition decisions to tens of milliseconds. Across synthetic benchmarks and latent-space optimisation tasks, SABLE achieves high sample efficiency and reduces decision time by several orders of magnitude at large budgets.

</details>


### [322] [Piano2Pop: Expanding Piano Demos into Pop Productions Without Aligned Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31510)
*Yun-Chen Cheng,Chih-Pin Tan,Tzu-Hung Huang,Yi-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Piano2Pop任务与伪监督方法，将钢琴MIDI扩展为流行器乐作品，无需对齐的钢琴-流行配对监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缺乏对齐的钢琴-流行成对数据，需探索如何在无配对监督下把钢琴MIDI扩展为完整流行编曲。

Method: 在预训练flow-matching模型上以钢琴卷帘为条件；用从流行录音构造的合成钢琴-器乐对训练；比较无配对转写（含FST功能选择与RDA音区密度增强）与配对监督的钢琴翻奏生成器作为伪示例来源。

Result: 在476个真实钢琴翻奏/流行对上，配对监督方法在真实钢琴输入的FAD、伴奏提示贴合度和频谱形状上最优；FST可缓解无配对训练中的钢琴过重问题；所有微调系统显著优于零样本基线。

Conclusion: 任务特定建模对Piano2Pop有效，配对监督伪示例最优，FST为有前景的无配对替代方案。

Abstract: We introduce Piano2Pop, a music-expansion task that transforms piano MIDI into instrumental pop productions. Enabled by recent advances in music generation and polyphonic music transcription, our pseudo-supervised approach conditions a pretrained flow-matching model on piano rolls without aligned piano-pop supervision. We train on synthetic piano-instrumental pairs derived from pop recordings, comparing pair-free transcription, including function-selective (FST) and register-density (RDA) augmentations, with a pair-supervised piano-cover generator as pseudo-demo sources. On 476 testing real-world piano-cover/pop pairs, the pair-supervised approach achieves the best Frechet Audio Distance, Accompaniment Prompt Adherence, and spectral shape on real-piano inputs, while FST mitigates piano-heavy outputs in pair-free training and remains a promising alternative. All fine-tuned systems significantly outperform the zero-shot baselines, which suggests a role for task-specific modeling.

</details>


### [323] [PYTHIA, a transferable machine learning framework for simultaneous defect and adsorption site optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31539)
*Ioannis Kouroudis,Zhaosu Gu,Poonam,Leon Muller,Alessio Gagliardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PYTHIA框架，结合基础模型、迁移学习与高斯过程不确定性量化，实现小样本新材料优化，并用于贝叶斯优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习在材料优化中价值高，但依赖大量样本，难以应用于数据稀少的新颖或未被充分研究的材料体系。

Method: 采用在化学相似分子大数据上训练的基础模型（目标与预测目标物理相近）；冻结权重后，用transformer层做子空间对齐，并加高斯过程进行不确定性量化；这两层只需有限数据即可训练，所得模型作为贝叶斯优化的代理模型。

Result: 应用于两个不同体系的吸附与缺陷优化任务，能够正确且高效地识别复杂吸附位点等最优解，显示框架的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: PYTHIA通过基础模型+迁移学习+不确定性量化，把机器学习拓展到少样本的新颖材料体系，并与贝叶斯优化结合实现高效材料优化。

Abstract: Machine learning has permeated material optimization, providing high value. Nevertheless, its re- liance on a high number of samples limits its applicability to relatively explored material families. In this paper we extend the applicability of machine learning to novel and understudied materials through the PYTHIA (Probabilistic Yet Transferable Hierarchical Interaction Architecture) framework. Pythia utilizes two of the most powerful machine learning concepts, foundational models and transfer learning. We employ a complex foundational model trained on a large dataset of chemically similar molecules, on a target that is physically close to our prediction target. Then, we freeze the weights and perform subspace alignment with the use of a transformer layer and add uncertainty quantification with gaussian processes. These two layers can be trained on a limited dataset yet allow us to leverage the gained knowl- edge and the studied materials and complex architectures. The resulting model is used as a surrogate for a Bayesian Optimization scheme. To showcase the robustness of the framework, we applied it to the investigation of adsorption and defect optimization of two distinct systems. Not only were we able to correctly and efficiently identify the optimal adsorption sites of even complex a

</details>


### [324] [Same Luck, Different Choice: Twin-World Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31544)
*Zeropy Surio,Tobias Engel,Mei-Lin Chou,Anika Raman,Samuel Okafor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TWICE通过"双世界"耦合噪声实现无偏、低方差的回合级信用分配，显著提升GRPO在问答基准上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体强化学习只奖励完整回合，但策略需要为回合内每个决策分配信用。反事实分支重跑回合来估计信用，但分支采样噪声与真实回合独立，导致结果差异混杂了决策效应与后续运气，噪声过大。

Method: 观察到智能体搜索中检索器、语料、评分器都是确定性的，回合是策略决策与采样噪声的确定性函数。据此提出TWICE：以turn和line为键对每个token的Gumbel噪声进行耦合，使反事实"孪生"继承真实回合的下游噪声，仅改变决策；将配对结果差异转化为回合级优势用于策略梯度更新，仅部署actor。采用平方根规则按预测分歧/单位成本分配孪生预算。

Result: 孪生信用对任意耦合质量都无偏，方差为独立反事实方差乘以1-ρ（ρ为孪生结果相关性）；耦合下解决大小为Δ的优势所需rollout数从Θ(Δ^{-2})降到Θ(Δ^{-1})。在7个问答基准上，TWICE使GRPO平均精确匹配在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上分别提升5.3和4.5个百分点，优于树搜索和反事实分支基线，辅助token比VinePPO少68%。

Conclusion: 利用确定性环境实现噪声耦合的双世界反事实估计，是一种高效、无偏且低方差的回合内信用分配方法，在问答任务上兼具效果与效率优势。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning rewards a complete episode, yet the policy needs credit for every decision inside it. Counterfactual branching estimates this credit by re-running the episode after an alternative decision, but the branch draws its sampling noise independently of the factual episode, so the outcome difference mixes the effect of the decision with the luck of everything that follows. We observe that in agentic search the retriever, the corpus, and the grader are deterministic, so an episode is a deterministic function of the policy's decisions and its sampling noise. Twin worlds are therefore realizable: the same noise, a different decision. We introduce TWICE (TWIn-world Credit Estimation), which keys the Gumbel noise of every token by turn and line, rolls out counterfactual twins that inherit the factual episode's downstream noise, and turns their paired outcome differences into turn-level advantages for policy-gradient updates on actor-sampled trajectories; only the actor is deployed. Twin credit is unbiased for any coupling quality, its variance is that of an independent counterfactual scaled by $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the twins' outcome correlation, and under coupling the number of rollouts needed to resolve an advantage of size $Δ$ falls from $Θ(Δ^{-2})$ to $Θ(Δ^{-1})$. A square-root rule spends the twin budget where outcomes are predicted to disagree per unit cost. On seven question-answering benchmarks, TWICE improves the average exact match of GRPO by 5.3 and 4.5 points on Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, outperforms tree-search and counterfactual-branching baselines, and uses 68% fewer auxiliary tokens than VinePPO.

</details>


### [325] [Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31558)
*Ali Al-Lawati,Elsayed Eshra,Dongwon Lee,Suhang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将连续隐空间攻击框架直接耦合到学习的扩散语言模型(dLLM)，替代随机映射，使生成对抗提示更自然且风险估计更可信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续空间攻击通过随机映射和最近邻token查找解码，产生的提示高度不自然，易被输入护栏检测，且其风险估计不基于自然提示。

Method: 保留标准高斯隐空间表示及下游采样/优化流程，用连续扩散语言模型(dLLM)提供学习的语言生成分布替换人工随机映射。在两种设置下评估：基于RareTrap的采样估计与基于ThinkTrap的优化搜索。

Result: 字符级困惑度显著下降：RareTrap从10^3–10^7降至3–5，ThinkTrap从20–28降至4.3–5.4；同时两种映射下的模型风险估计可相差一个数量级。

Conclusion: 用学习式dLLM替换随机映射可在不改变框架的前提下生成更自然的对抗提示，并显著影响风险评估结果，说明映射选择对安全评估至关重要。

Abstract: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.

</details>


### [326] [Shift-aware score transport for privacy auditing without retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31549)
*Yaohong Yang,Gauri Pradhan,Qi Chen,Samuel Kaski,Antti Honkela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对观测式隐私审计中可用的非成员数据与训练分布存在偏移的问题，提出利用OOD非成员估计反事实的分布内非成员分数分布，并引入保守校正来稳定隐私损失下界估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在观测式审计场景下（无法插入canary、无法控制数据纳入、无法重训模型），审计者只能依赖固定的已知成员与非成员集合；但可用非成员可能与训练数据分布不同，导致成员推断分数受分布偏移影响而产生偏斜，进而给出不稳定的隐私下界。

Method: 从OOD非成员中学习数据表征与成员推断分数之间的关系，并将该关系迁移到目标协变量分布上，以估计反事实的分布内非成员分数分布；针对外推和条件不变性不完美导致迁移不可靠的问题，设计直接以名义迁移隐私水平为标定的保守校正；利用可用非成员数据构造受控标定任务，估计表征空间位移如何抬高审计结果，并用该估计修正迁移导致的审计误差。

Result: 在多个存在分布偏移的数据集上，该方法给出的隐私估计显著更稳定，同时在保持更紧的下界方面优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 观测式隐私审计中的分布偏移可通过表征层面的分数迁移加保守校正得到有效缓解，从而在无法重训或受访问限制的实际部署模型上获得更可靠且更紧的隐私损失下界。

Abstract: Privacy auditing empirically assesses privacy leakage by using membership inference attacks to establish lower bounds on privacy loss. We consider an observational auditing setting in which the auditor cannot insert canaries, control data inclusion, or retrain the target model, and must instead rely on fixed sets of known members and non-members. This setting is relevant for large deployed models or when retraining is restricted by computational or access constraints. In this case, non-members available for auditing may differ in distribution from the training data, causing membership-inference scores to be skewed due to the distribution shift. We address this problem by estimating the counterfactual in-distribution non-member score distribution using the available out-of-distribution (OOD) non-members. Our proposed method learns the relationship between data representations and membership-inference scores from OOD non-members and transports it to the target covariate distribution. Because this transport may become unreliable under extrapolation or imperfect conditional invariance, we further introduce a conservative correction calibrated directly to the nominal transported privacy level. We construct controlled calibration tasks from the available non-member data to estimate how representation-space displacement inflates the audit, and use this estimate to correct the transport-induced audit error. Across multiple datasets with distribution shifts, our method yields substantially more stable privacy estimates while retaining tighter lower bounds than baselines.

</details>


### [327] [Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31657)
*Sachin Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将“成本感知弃权”作为离线、成本条件下的就绪性评估框架：在标定数据上按显式成本选择路由策略，再在冻结后于测试集上一次性评估。公开的47,837条、八类IT工单语料上，阈值0.60的逻辑回归把测试成本从0.763降至0.472（相对降38.1%），错误路由从15.3%降至3.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IT支持工单的自动路由错误代价高于转人工分诊，因此需要在显式成本下评估“自动路由还是转人工”的弃权决策；现有评估常混淆标定与测试、或只看准确率，缺乏成本条件化的就绪性判断。

Method: 在公开47,837条、八类工单语料上，比较4个非LLM训练分类器与4个LLM（零样本/少样本提示）；在标定集上按成本(c_ok,c_triage,c_wrong)=(0,1,5)选择阈值并冻结策略，测试集仅评估一次；报告正确性AUROC、tie-aware risk-coverage面积、ECE，并设LLM-only一致性对照与margin/entropy拒绝基线；附成本参数敏感性的事后分析。

Result: TF-IDF+逻辑回归阈值0.60使测试成本0.763→0.472（相对降38.1%，95%CI[35.7%,40.4%]），错误路由15.3%→3.5%；16个设定中14个冻结策略优于always-route与always-defer。最强提示配置在1,000条分层子集上准确率0.477，微调DistilBERT为0.879。等渗校准降低ECE但不稳定提升判别力（GPT-4o-mini少样本仅单一置信值，AUROC 0.500）。解析盈亏平衡概率0.80处，七个提示配置全部弃权，Haiku少样本仅路由19/1000。

Conclusion: 成本感知弃权可作为可复用的离线就绪性评估框架，但并非新弃权算法或通用部署认证；结论仅限该数据集、提示设计、模型端点与示例成本。细调小模型在本任务显著优于提示LLM，且需同时报告AUROC/风险-覆盖面积与ECE以分离校准与判别。

Abstract: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.

</details>


### [328] [Fine-Grained Analysis of Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Learning via Algorithmic Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31551)
*Guodong Zheng,Yan Sun,Peng Wang,Enneng Yang,Jiafei Lyu,Xiaochun Cao,Dacheng Tao,Li Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个不依赖特定模型架构的算法稳定性框架，分析SGD下持续学习的期望遗忘，将遗忘分解为任务内/跨任务泛化差距与经验遗忘，并为常数、任务内衰减、连续衰减三种学习率调度给出上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习遗忘的理论分析依赖特定模型或任务结构，且难以揭示迭代优化过程如何影响遗忘。作者希望建立更通用、能刻画优化动态的遗忘理论。

Method: 基于算法稳定性分析SGD下的期望总体遗忘：将遗忘分解为任务内泛化差距、跨任务泛化差距和经验遗忘；通过追踪样本扰动在任务内更新及后续任务中的传播来界定泛化差距；对比任务内衰减与连续衰减两种学习率调度，刻画任务边界处学习率衰减重启对历史扰动传播的影响；对经验遗忘在不要求凸性的条件下，沿优化轨迹保留累积梯度对齐以推导上界。

Result: 给出三种学习率调度下期望遗忘的上界，这些上界显式反映训练集大小、每任务更新次数、任务总数、学习率调度及累积梯度对齐的影响。在Split CIFAR-100与Split MiniImageNet上的实验验证了理论发现的实证意义。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了架构无关的持续学习遗忘理论框架，揭示学习率调度与优化轨迹（梯度对齐）对遗忘的作用机制，为理解和缓解灾难性遗忘提供理论指导。

Abstract: Understanding catastrophic forgetting, in which learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned tasks, remains a fundamental challenge in continual learning (CL). Existing theoretical analyses often rely on specific model or task structures and offer limited insight into how iterative optimization affects forgetting. To address this gap, we develop an algorithmic stability framework for expected population forgetting under SGD without prescribing a particular model architecture. Specifically, we decompose forgetting into intra-task and cross-task generalization gaps and empirical forgetting. To bound the generalization gaps, we track how a sample perturbation affects updates within a task and propagates through subsequent tasks. We consider constant, intra-task decaying, and continuously decaying learning-rate schedules. Comparing the two decaying schedules allows us to characterize how restarting learning-rate decay at task boundaries affects the propagation of historical sample perturbations. For empirical forgetting, we derive bounds for all three schedules by retaining cumulative gradient alignment along the optimization trajectory, without requiring convexity. Combining these results yields upper bounds on expected forgetting that capture the effects of training set size, the number of updates per task, the total number of tasks, learning-rate schedules, and cumulative gradient alignment. Finally, we conduct experiments on Split CIFAR-100 and Split MiniImageNet to examine the empirical implications of our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [329] [When to Follow the Teacher: Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31563)
*Mahdi Sabbaghi,George Pappas,Hamed Hassani,Adel Javanmard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出优势加权在线策略蒸馏 AOPD，用学生采样轨迹的可估计反事实优势给教师动作加权，无需额外 rollout 即可聚焦真正有益指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 OPD 假设教师指导总有益，在每个状态都让学生跟随教师，忽略了“教师偏好”与“真正帮助学生成功”之间的差异。

Method: 用学生在学生状态下的反事实优势对教师动作加权：有益动作强化、无益动作降权。通过在学生采样动作上使用教师重要性权重，可从标准学生 rollout 及终端奖励中获得无偏的优势加权监督估计，无需额外 rollout 或奖励评估。

Result: 在数学、编程、MedQA 上，外部教师与自蒸馏两种设置均优于蒸馏和 RL 基线。

Conclusion: AOPD 保留标准 OPD 的 rollout 效率，同时将教师监督集中于对当前学生真正有帮助的动作。

Abstract: Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student. However, standard OPD trains the student to follow the teacher at every state of the trajectory, assuming that teacher guidance is always beneficial. We instead distinguish between what the teacher prefers and what actually helps the current student succeed. We introduce Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which weights teacher actions by their counterfactual advantage under the student. Teacher actions that improve the student's expected outcome are reinforced, while those that do not are downweighted.
  Directly computing these advantages requires trying alternative teacher actions at each step and running new rollouts from each. Instead, we show that the AOPD objective can be estimated using only standard student rollouts and their terminal rewards. Our estimator uses teacher importance weights on the student-sampled actions to provide unbiased advantage-weighted supervision, without any additional rollouts or reward evaluations. This allows AOPD to focus teacher supervision on actions that help the current student while preserving the rollout efficiency of standard OPD. Experiments on math, coding, and Medqa show gains over distillation and RL baselines in both external-teacher and self-distillation settings.

</details>


### [330] [On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31572)
*Andrea Giuseppe Di Francesco,Rishabh Jain,Franco Maria Nardini,Nicola Tonellotto,Pietro Liò,Fabrizio Silvestri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文深入分析G-Retriever等图软提示方法，发现普遍存在"token collapse"（token坍缩）病理现象：图token在不同输入间几乎不可区分，实为通用软提示而非传递图信息，并提出两阶段评估程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图软提示被广泛用于将图结构注入LLM提示，但缺乏对图token是否真正传递图信息的严谨验证，作者质疑现有方法（如G-Retriever）的有效性依赖。

Method: 在3个基准、3种图编码器、2类LLM（冻结与LoRA）上做干预实验：替换token为数据集均值、其他样本token、损坏图token，并对比不访问图的学习常量提示；用干预与解码探针区分token编码的是问题、答案先验还是图内容。

Result: G-Retriever的图token在不同输入间几乎相同；替换或损坏token对答案准确率无显著影响；常量软提示即可匹配或超越G-Retriever。该方法失效被后续多token池化方法继承。

Conclusion: 坍缩token仅起通用软提示作用，token变异性不等于图信息被利用；任务准确率不足以推断图token对齐，需用干预与探针方法评估。作者提出两阶段程序可产生非坍缩token，多数情况保持竞争力。

Abstract: Recent methods for injecting graph structure into LLM prompts include graph soft prompting, in which a graph neural network (GNN) learns graph-specific tokens that capture relational information among entities in textual prompts. G-Retriever combines graph soft prompts with a verbalized description of the same graph to strengthen the textual prompt signal. We conduct an in-depth analysis of G-Retriever and uncover a pathological behavior we term token collapse. Across three benchmarks, three graph encoders, two LLM families, and both frozen and LoRA-adapted models, G-Retriever's graph tokens become almost indistinguishable across inputs. We provide evidence that the same failure is inherited by subsequent methods, even with multi-token pooling. Under the standard setup, swapping a token with the dataset mean, a token from another example, or one derived from a corrupted graph produces no resolved answer-level effect in accuracy. Moreover, a learned constant prompt that never accesses the graph matches or surpasses G-Retriever on all three benchmarks. These findings indicate that, rather than conveying graph content as intended, the collapsed token functions primarily as a generic soft prompt. We also examine conditions linked to this collapse and propose a two-stage procedure that yields non-collapsed tokens while maintaining competitive performance in most cases. However, token variability alone does not prove that the model uses graph information: via interventions and decoding probes, we show that depending on the configuration, a token can reflect the question, an answer prior, or graph-derived content that the LLM may or may not use. Overall, our results offer a practical approach to evaluating graph-token alignment rather than inferring it from task accuracy alone. Code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/Token_Collapse_KGQA.

</details>


### [331] [Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31574)
*Sihan Yang,Jie Huang,Hanxuan Li,Yifan Guo,Weigao Sun,Yiran Zhong,Weiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TTR-Compressor，将序列压缩重新表述为测试时回归问题：输入 token 定义一个回归问题，其闭式求解的拟合系数即作为压缩表示，回归问题本身端到端学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列压缩是高效语言模型与多模态模型的关键信息瓶颈，但现有基于池化或学习投影的方法性能不理想，需要更有效的压缩原语。

Method: 以测试时回归视角重构压缩：输入 token 构成回归问题，前向时高效闭式计算回归系数作为压缩表示，回归目标/问题参数通过反向传播端到端学习。作为通用替代方案，应用于块级稀疏注意力压缩器与多模态大模型的视觉 token 合并器。

Result: 在块级稀疏注意力上，RULER 性能大幅超过基于注意力的压缩器；在视觉 token 合并上，持续优于标准 MLP merger，并在视觉 token 减少 55.6% 时达到其相当性能。

Conclusion: 测试时回归是一种有效的序列压缩基础原语，可广泛用于高效语言与多模态模型。

Abstract: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. These results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.

</details>


### [332] [Action Learning for Scientific Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31585)
*Sarah Liaw,Yuanqi Du,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"动作学习"(action learning)问题，即从轨迹观测中恢复随机动作，并提出LEAP方法——将未知动作锚定在可处理的参考过程上，通过与参考轨迹对比学习修正项，得到路径空间上的可微目标，可统一用于轨迹排序、推断、机制引导、约束优化与采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解与控制系统演化需要推理完整轨迹。现有方法要么学习局部动力学、要么生成轨迹：基于单个转移构建的目标会遗漏跨时间依赖，生成模型又缺乏可处理的目标来评估和优化任意路径。因此需要一个统一的、作用于整条路径的目标函数。

Method: 提出LEAP（Learned Energy on Action Paths）：把未知动作锚定到一个可处理的参考过程，通过比较观测轨迹与参考轨迹来学习剩余修正项，由此在路径空间构造出可微目标，既能刻画局部动力学结构，又能捕捉非可加的跨时间依赖。学到的同一动作可复用。

Result: 在随机物理系统、多体轨道动力学和分子模拟中，LEAP能恢复底层动力学、捕捉跨时间依赖，并支持跨不同推断目标与物理条件的迁移。

Conclusion: 动作学习是将轨迹观测转化为可复用目标的有效框架，为科学推断与控制提供统一工具。

Abstract: Understanding and controlling how systems evolve is central to science and engineering, where many problems require reasoning about complete trajectories. Existing approaches typically learn local dynamics or generate trajectories, but objectives constructed from individual transitions can miss dependencies across time, while generative models do not necessarily provide a tractable objective for evaluating and optimizing arbitrary paths. We study $\textit{action learning}$, the problem of recovering a stochastic action from trajectory observations, yielding a common objective for reasoning about dynamical systems. We introduce $\textbf{LEAP}$ ($\textbf{L}$earned $\textbf{E}$nergy on $\textbf{A}$ction $\textbf{P}$aths), which anchors the unknown action to a tractable reference process and learns the remaining correction by comparing observed trajectories with reference trajectories. This construction yields a differentiable objective on path space that can capture both local dynamical structure and nonadditive dependencies across time. Once learned, the same action can be flexibly reused for path ranking and inference, mechanism steering, constrained optimization and sampling. Across stochastic physical systems, many-body orbital dynamics and molecular simulations, LEAP recovers underlying dynamics, captures dependencies across time and enables transfer across inference objectives and physical conditions. We show that $\textit{action learning}$ is a promising framework for turning trajectory observations into reusable objectives for scientific inference and control.

</details>


### [333] [CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31594)
*Franco Rugolon,Ioanna Miliou,Panagiotis Papapetrou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CRANE是首个面向多模态分类器的后置、模型无关的最近邻反事实解释框架，通过从目标类别中检索真实训练样本作为解释，并提出多模态共识检索（MC-R）策略，在四个数据集上取得最佳或并列最佳表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反事实解释方法仅针对单模态（表格、时序、文本、图像）设计，缺乏针对多模态分类器的后置方法；已有的多模态可解释性方法对各模态独立施加归因，无法产生连贯解释，且无法迁移到任意预训练多模态架构。

Method: 提出CRANE框架：检索目标类别中的真实训练样本作为候选反事实解释，从构造上保证解释的合理性（plausibility by construction）；框架为后置、模型无关的。核心策略为多模态共识检索（MC-R），即取各模态近邻集合的交集，找出在每个模态上都与查询样本接近的实例。实验覆盖四个异构数据集和三种融合策略。

Result: MC-R在四个数据集中的三个上取得最佳或并列最佳效果，且每个解释都锚定于联合训练分布；当单一模态主导决策边界时，单模态策略仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: CRANE填补了多模态分类器反事实解释的空白，MC-R作为最强的多模态策略在多数场景下表现优异，但模态主导情形下单模态方法仍可竞争，说明最优策略依赖数据特性。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. Existing explainability methods for multimodal classifiers apply modality-specific attribution independently to each input, which fails to yield coherent explanations and does not transfer to arbitrary pre-trained multimodal architectures. To address these shortcomings, we present CRANE (Counterfactual Retrieval via Agnostic Nearest-neighbour Explanations), the first post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for nearest-neighbour multimodal counterfactual generation that retrieves real training examples from the target class as candidate explanations, ensuring plausibility by construction. Across four heterogeneous datasets and three fusion strategies, we show that Multimodal Consensus Retrieval (MC-R), which intersects per-modality neighbour sets to identify instances jointly close to the query in every modality, emerges as the strongest multimodal strategy, achieving the best or joint-best outcome on three of four datasets while grounding every explanation in the joint training distribution. Unimodal strategies remain competitive when a single modality dominates the decision boundary.

</details>


### [334] [Efficient and Optimal Learning of Discrete Distributions with Person-Level Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31612)
*Gautam Kamath,Mahbod Majid,Ankur Moitra,Argyris Mouzakis,Jonathan Ullman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究批量（batched）设置下、用户级差分隐私约束下的离散分布学习问题，分别给出纯DP与近似DP的样本量最优（至对数因子）的多项式时间算法，核心是新的六次平方和（SoS）估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在每个用户贡献 m 个样本、追求总变差误差 α 的目标下，需要刻画达到最优精度所需的用户数 n 随 k、α、m、ε 的依赖关系；此前纯DP下的多项式时间保证未能匹配信息论最优。

Method: 采用"不可信批量"框架：先对批次均值做鲁棒修复，再用度-6平方和（SoS）估计器学习。关键技术是构造经验协方差与多项式协方差之差的轨迹有界对角主控子（trace-bounded diagonal majorizer），借助SDP对偶及Friedland–Lim 的对称 Grothendieck 不等式更强形式，证明干净数据满足该证书；证书保留依赖均值的多项式方差，给出 O(η√(log(1/η)/m)) 的鲁棒速率并提供隐私归约所需的得分。

Result: 纯(ε,0)-DP 下用户数 n = Õ(k/(α²m) + k/(α√m ε) + k/ε)，是首个（对数因子内）匹配信息论最优的多项式时间纯DP保证；近似(ε,δ)-DP 下 n = Õ(k/(α²m) + k/(α√m ε) + k + log(1/δ)/ε)，当 δ=2^{-Θ(k)} 且 α,ε,m 固定时为 Õ(k)。另给出统计查询（SQ）下界，表明在固定多项式SQ资源下无法一致地取得更小的误差阶。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了批量设置下用户级DP分布学习的近乎最优算法，度-6 SoS 与轨迹有界对角主控证书是核心工具；SQ 下界说明所得结果是该类资源模型下的本质极限。

Abstract: We study learning a discrete distribution under person-level differential privacy in the batched setting. Given $n$ users, each contributing $m$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $μ$ over $[k]$, we seek an estimate of $μ$ with total-variation error $α$. We give polynomial-time algorithms under both pure and approximate differential privacy. Under pure $(\varepsilon,0)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k/\varepsilon)$, the first polynomial-time pure-DP guarantee matching the information-theoretic optimum up to logarithmic factors. Under approximate $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k+\log(1/δ)/\varepsilon)$. At $δ=2^{-Θ(k)}$, this is $\widetilde O(k)$ for fixed $α,\varepsilon,m$ and failure probability. Our algorithms use a new degree-6 sum-of-squares estimator for learning from untrusted batches. Its key ingredient is a trace-bounded diagonal majorizer for the difference between the empirical covariance of the repaired batch averages and the multinomial covariance predicted by their mean. We prove that clean data admit this certificate through semidefinite-programming duality and a new application of the stronger symmetric form of Grothendieck's inequality due to Friedland and Lim. The certificate preserves the mean-dependent variance of multinomial batch averages, yielding the near-optimal robust rate $O(η\sqrt{\log(1/η)/m})$ and providing the score required by the privacy reduction. We also prove a statistical query lower bound ruling out a uniformly smaller order of error under fixed polynomial SQ resource bounds.

</details>


### [335] [OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31616)
*Qi Li,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次研究on-policy自蒸馏中的成员推断攻击，发现监督印记稀疏且集中于不确定敏感的修正位置，提出统一攻击框架OP-Print，在灰盒与黑盒设定下均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: on-policy自蒸馏无需外部教师、实用性强，但其隐私风险几乎未被探索；尤其同一训练样本的两个耦合视图可能加剧记忆，因此需要研究成员推断攻击。

Method: 揭示on-policy自蒸馏的监督印记稀疏且结构化（集中在不确定敏感的修正位点），据此构建OP-Print：灰盒下直接聚合同一rollout上的特权教师-学生残差修正；黑盒下用基于重启的输出盆地稳定性作为隐藏修正过程的可观测代理。

Result: 在多种模型和蒸馏方案下，所有基线攻击即使在灰盒访问下也基本处于随机猜测水平，而OP-Print在灰盒与黑盒设定中均被广泛验证有效。

Conclusion: on-policy自蒸馏存在可利用的成员泄露风险，其稀疏结构化的修正印记可作为有效攻击信号；OP-Print为两种威胁模型提供统一且有效的成员推断方案。

Abstract: On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. This teacher-free design makes on-policy self-distillation practical, yet its privacy risks remain largely unexplored. In particular, using two coupled views of the same training example may strengthen its memorization. Motivated by this, we present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation. We investigate both gray-box and black-box threat models and propose a unified attack framework, named OP-Print. OP-Print builds on our finding that the supervision imprint in on-policy self-distillation is sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout. Exploiting this property, we construct attack signals tailored to the two access levels: in the gray-box setting, OP-Print directly aggregates the privileged teacher-student residual correction along the same rollout; in the black-box setting, it measures restart-based output-basin stability as an observable surrogate for the hidden correction process. Across diverse models and distillation schemes, all baseline attacks remain essentially at random guessing even under gray-box access, whereas OP-Print is broadly validated to be effective in both gray-box and black-box settings.

</details>


### [336] [Questioning Instrumental Convergence in RLVR: Checkpoint Evidence from OLMo-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31624)
*Barış Alparslan,Sandy Tanwisuth,Caleb Petterson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）是否会使模型更易表现出工具性趋同行为，发现其并非单调增加，而是先升后降的行为轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具性趋同被认为能力强的智能体可能习得自保、资源获取、欺骗、抵抗监督等权力寻求子目标，对社会构成威胁。对LLM而言，强化学习是后训练中直接针对目标优化行为的第一个阶段，因此理论上最可能出现趋同工具性行为。作者想检验RLVR是否真的使模型更易表达此类行为，还是取决于训练方式、评估框架和后训练阶段。

Method: 采用InstrumentalEval，将问题建模为checkpoint条件下的行为轨迹而非单一安全分数。评估OLMo-3-7B-Think在SFT、DPO、13个中间RLVR检查点及最终RLVR模型上的表现。使用配对条目级检验和逐步回归分析，并考察有害提示等框架效应（仅解释平均15%的检查点内方差），再用迭代零空间投影（INLP）移除可检测的提示框架方向。

Result: 轨迹非单调：工具性行为率从SFT的25.0%上升到RLVR约第200步的46.1%，再降至最终检查点的11.8%。配对检验与逐步回归支持SFT到最终RLVR的下降。INLP移除框架方向后SFT-to-final差距不变。初步的32B端点结果（SFT 35.53% → RLVR最终22.37%）方向一致。

Conclusion: 在该设定下RLVR并不单调增加工具性行为：比率早期上升，随后降至SFT基线以下。结论特定于该模型家族与基准，评判者一致性为中等，绝对比率需谨慎解读。

Abstract: Instrumental convergence is often invoked as a general reason to expect capable agents to acquire or express power-seeking subgoals: self-preservation, resource acquisition, deception, or resistance to oversight which poses an important threat to the society. For LLMs, reinforcement learning is the first stage of post-training that directly optimizes behavior against an objective; therefore, it is the stage where convergent instrumental behavior, on IC grounds, likely to appear. Does reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make a model more likely to express instrumental-convergence behavior, or does this depend on the training regime, evaluation frame, and stage of post-training? We study this question as a checkpoint-conditioned behavioral trajectory rather than as a single before/after safety score. Using InstrumentalEval, we evaluate OLMo-3-7B-Think across SFT, DPO, 13 intermediate RLVR checkpoints, and the final RLVR model. The trajectory is nonmonotonic: instrumental rate rises from 25.0% at SFT to 46.1% near RLVR step 200, then falls to 11.8% at the final checkpoint. Paired item-level tests and step-wise regression support the final SFT-to-RLVR reduction. Prompt framing does not explain this pattern: a harmful-prompt indicator combined with other framing effects explains only 15% of within-checkpoint score variance on average, and Iterative Null-space Projection (INLP) removes a detectable framing direction without changing the SFT-to-final-RLVR gap. Together with preliminary 32B endpoint results (35.53% SFT to 22.37% RLVR final), these findings indicate that RLVR does not monotonically increase instrumental behavior in this setting: the rate rises early, then falls below the SFT baseline. The result is specific to this model family and benchmark, and judge agreement is moderate, so absolute rates should be read cautiously.

</details>


### [337] [BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31633)
*Hayden Prairie,Jacob M. Ryan,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Daniel Y. Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究如何在循环（looped）架构中实现 KV-cache 跨递推（深度）共享（KV-shareability），提出两阶段方法（预训练用 stochastic depth，后训练用 BeNice!），在保持质量的同时实现 KV 共享，并与其它 KV 压缩方法互补，显著提升长上下文推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Looped 架构参数固定但每次递推都生成独立 KV-cache，导致显存随递推次数线性增长。已有工作发现某些情况下最终递推的 KV-cache 可被早期递推共享而不损质量，但该性质的机制不清，甚至相同训练的模型也未必稳定具备。

Method: 两阶段方法。第一阶段：预训练时使用 stochastic depth，诱导收缩型残差动力学，使各递推的表示趋向共同极限。第二阶段：提出后训练方法 BeNice!，将最终递推的 KV-cache 广播到第一次递推，训练其产生兼容的残差，同时保持原模型质量。

Result: BeNice! 实现了 KV-shareability，且不共享验证困惑度与标准微调持平。KV 共享与其它 KV 压缩方法互补：可与 memory-efficient 序列混合器（MLA、Kimi delta attention）及低精度 KV 量化（fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4）组合。模拟低显存长上下文推理中，缓存命中率最高 +31.4%，吞吐最高 +23.6%，p90 首 token 时延最多降低 83.6%。

Conclusion: KV-shareability 可通过 stochastic depth 预训练加 BeNice! 后训练可靠地获得，无需牺牲质量，并与多种 KV 压缩手段组合，实用于低显存长上下文推理场景。

Abstract: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers. During inference, each recurrence generates independent KV-caches, causing memory to grow linearly. To address this challenge, prior work has proposed KV-sharing (i.e., sharing KV-caches across depth), finding that, in some cases, the KV-cache of the final recurrence can be shared with the earlier recurrences without quality loss, a property we denote as KV-shareability. However, the mechanisms underlying KV-shareability remain poorly understood, with even identically trained looped architectures not consistently exhibiting it. In this paper, we study how KV-shareability can be enabled in looped models. We propose a two-stage method: in the first stage, we use stochastic depth during pretraining, which induces contractive residual dynamics that drive representations toward a common limit across recurrences. In the second stage, we propose BeNice!, a post-training method that broadcasts the final recurrence's KV-cache into the first recurrence, training it to produce compatible residuals while preserving the original model's quality. As a result, BeNice! enables KV-shareability while matching standard finetuning's unshared validation perplexity. Using BeNice!, we show that KV-sharing is complementary to alternative KV-compression methods, composing with memory-efficient sequence mixers (e.g., multi-latent attention, Kimi delta attention) and low-precision KV-cache quantization (e.g., fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4). Finally, in simulated low-memory, long-context inference, KV-sharing improves cache hit rates by up to 31.4%, increases throughput by up to 23.6%, and reduces p90 time-to-first-token by up to 83.6%.

</details>


### [338] [Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31639)
*Gabriele Dominici,Teague McMillan,Fazl Barez,Marc Langheinrich,Martin Gjoreski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CausalCoT 推理框架，将问题分解为原子子问题的有向无环图，每个节点仅在包含其直接因果父节点的隔离上下文中求解，从而阻断注意力对非父内容的泄漏，使 CoT 步骤真正因果驱动最终答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自回归生成中密集注意力使每个推理步骤都能看到完整上下文，模型可通过直接查找得出答案，再生成看似合理的事后理由；因此 CoT 的步骤并不保证因果地决定最终答案，解释忠实性无法保证。

Method: CausalCoT 在推理阶段把问题拆成原子子问题构成的 DAG，每个节点只在仅含其直接因果父节点的隔离上下文中评估，形成马尔可夫结构，切断通往非父内容的注意力通路，使下游预测依赖局部推理而非全局上下文泄漏。

Result: 在多种推理基准上保持有竞争力的预测性能，同时提升解释忠实性：中间推理步骤的因果敏感度平均提升 12 个百分点，最高提升 21 个百分点（相对最强基线）；依赖图还支持测试时干预，局部纠错可沿下游可预测地传播。

Conclusion: 通过结构化的因果隔离上下文，CausalCoT 在不大幅牺牲准确率的前提下显著增强 CoT 的因果忠实性，并为可解释、可干预的推理提供可预测的传播机制。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregressive generation, dense attention allows each reasoning step to attend to the full context, enabling the model to derive answers through direct lookup while generating plausible-sounding but post-hoc justifications. We introduce CausalCoT, an inference framework that enforces causal transparency by decomposing problems into a directed acyclic graph of atomic sub-questions, evaluating each node in an isolated context containing only its direct causal parents. This Markovian structure removes attention pathways to non-parent content, making downstream predictions sensitive to local reasoning rather than global context leakage. Across a diverse suite of reasoning benchmarks, CausalCoT preserves competitive predictive performance while improving explanation faithfulness, increasing causal sensitivity of intermediate reasoning steps by an average of 12 and up to 21 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The structured dependency graph additionally enables test-time interventions in which local corrections propagate predictably through downstream reasoning.

</details>


### [339] [A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31642)
*Jonathan T. Barron,Dan Gnanapragasam,Michael Tschannen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 标准 softmax/log-softmax/cross-entropy 实现存在两个数值缺陷（Softmax Collapse 与 Softmax Cancellation），作者给出修正实现并验证了多项训练现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有标准实现中的数值 bug 会导致梯度不满足和为 0，或在师生 logits 相等时产生非零梯度，进而引发训练异常（如 Slingshot、精度崩溃、蒸馏漂移）。

Method: 提出简单修正版的 log-softmax、softmax 与 cross-entropy 实现，同时消除 Softmax Collapse 与 Softmax Cancellation 两个缺陷。

Result: 修复后消除了 "Slingshot" 现象；加速带权重衰减的 grokking；防止无权重衰减时的精度崩溃；阻止蒸馏中学生网络远离教师；并显示记忆后 logit 增长受权重衰减与 Adam ε 的平衡限制。

Conclusion: 数值实现细节对训练动态有实质影响；正确实现 softmax 系列函数可改善优化稳定性并揭示 logit 增长的理论边界。

Abstract: Standard implementations of softmax, log-softmax, and cross-entropy have two numerical bugs. The first bug, Softmax Collapse, rounds the target logit's gradient to zero if that one logit is much larger than the others, resulting in gradients that no longer sum to zero. The second bug, Softmax Cancellation, occurs when student logits are close to teacher logits, and produces non-zero gradients even when the student and teacher logits are equal. We present simple implementations of log-softmax, softmax, and cross-entropy that fix both bugs. Our fix eliminates the previously-observed "Slingshot" phenomenon, speeds up grokking with weight decay, prevents accuracy collapse without weight decay, stops student networks from drifting away from the teacher during distillation, and shows that after memorization, logit growth is bounded by an equilibrium between weight decay and Adam's $ε$ hyperparameter.

</details>


### [340] [METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31656)
*Ali Najar,Hosein Hasani,Amir Kooshan Fattah,Yasamin Rajabi,Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: METTA将元强化学习的快速适应分解为两种时间尺度：因果神经记忆做线性复杂度的回合内细粒度适应，压缩的回合级摘要支持跨回合长程任务推断，避免了对完整交互历史的二次注意力计算。在未见过的Meta-World ML10/45上成功率超50%且训练开销低、耗时短；在长上下文稀疏奖励PointMaze上优于Transformer基线，表现出更有结构的探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元强化学习需要从有限交互中快速适应新任务，但要在长交互历史上表征任务证据。经典循环智能体把经验压缩进隐状态（表达受限），而Transformer智能体需对过去轨迹做检索，内存与计算成本随序列长度呈二次增长，难以扩展到长上下文。

Method: 提出Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA)，把快速适应阶段分解为两个时间尺度：(1) 因果神经记忆以线性序列复杂度完成回合内的细粒度适应；(2) 紧凑的回合级摘要用于长程跨回合任务推断，无需对完整交互历史做注意力。神经记忆提供充足表达力与测试时训练能力，使智能体在元测试阶段可适应未见过的留出任务及任务族。

Result: 在未见的留出Meta-World ML10/45测试环境上成功率达50%以上，同时保持较低训练预算与较短实际耗时；在长上下文稀疏奖励的PointMaze任务上超越Transformer类基线，探索行为更具结构性。

Conclusion: METTA为更自适应、更可扩展的长上下文元强化学习提供了一条高效路径：用线性复杂度的分层记忆替代二次注意力，兼顾表达力与跨回合长程推断。

Abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for meta-reinforcement learning. It decomposes the fast adaptation phase into two temporal scales: a causal neural memory performs fine-grained within-episode adaptation with linear sequence complexity, while compact episode-level summaries support long-range cross-episode task inference without attending over the full interaction history. Moreover, equipping agents with neural memory provides sufficient expressive capacity and test-time training capability, enabling effective adaptation to unseen held-out tasks and task families at meta-test time. On unseen held-out Meta-World ML10/45 test environments, METTA achieves a success rate over $50\%$ while maintaining a low training budget and short wall-clock time. On long-context sparse-reward PointMaze tasks, it outperforms transformer-based baselines by exhibiting more structured exploration behavior. These results show that METTA provides an efficient path toward more adaptive and scalable long-context meta-RL.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [341] [Cutting a Cake For Human Consumption: An Elementary $n$-agent Cake Cutting Protocol](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30370)
*Alexandros Psomas*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文在Robertson–Webb模型中给出了任意n个代理的无嫉妒蛋糕切分协议，查询复杂度为2^{O(n log n)}，且证明简短、初等、自包含。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的无嫉妒蛋糕切分结果虽存在，但描述与正确性证明往往繁琐难懂；作者希望把已知的技术组件重新组织，得到一个完整描述与证明都能在几页内呈现的简单协议。

Method: 在Robertson–Webb（仅允许切分与查询、不要求整块分配）模型下，整合公平划分文献中已有的成熟技术组件，重新组织成一个有界查询的无嫉妒协议。

Result: 协议对任意n个代理均适用，使用2^{O(n log n)}次查询，并配有简短、自包含且初等的正确性证明。

Conclusion: 主要贡献不在于新技术，而在于更简洁的组织方式：将已知思想整合为一个可在数页内完整陈述并证明的无嫉妒蛋糕切分协议。

Abstract: We give a bounded envy-free cake-cutting protocol for any number $n$ of agents in the Robertson--Webb model, with a short, self-contained, and elementary correctness proof. The protocol uses $2^{O(n \log n)}$ queries. Most ingredients are already known and well understood in the fair division literature; our main contribution is a simpler organization of these ideas into a protocol whose complete description and proof fit in a few pages.

</details>


### [342] [Temporal Liquidity Crossing for Blockchains: An EIP-1559 Extension for Admission Below the Base Fee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30595)
*Duanyang Dan Guo*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出"时间流动性市场"(TLM)框架,让希望早区块执行的交易(消费者)资助自愿退出早区块的交易(提供者),并在区块局部扩展EIP-1559,允许提供者在基础费下限下入块,同时证明8项安全性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交易价值随执行时间和相对位置而变化,但EIP-1559的费用竞价无法保证更早位置,也无法表达"愿意接受更晚位置";基础费是硬性准入门槛,难以撮合互补的时间需求。

Method: 构建TLM交叉互补时间需求:消费者资助提供者在早区块区域的排除。区块局部EIP-1559扩展中,受资助且容量受限的提供者gas被排除在控制器输入之外(纳入会抬高基础费并挤走普通需求)。消费者按授权密度排序、由验证者校验;消费者支付其签署授权用于补足提供者差额,盈余销毁。给出含策略性发送者与构建者的对手模型并证明8条性质。

Result: 证明的性质包括:验证者校验的规则有效性、基础费全额销毁、无补贴;插入的消费者出价不能抬高其他消费者的费用。在提供者费用上限地板下,小且有上限的入块费加上与受资gas挂钩的消费者额度(足够大的链接比),任何有限插入的消费者或提供者都无法提高构建者的直接费用收益。

Conclusion: TLM在不改变无TLM时普通分配的前提下,让控制器按原目标调控普通需求,并在合成实验中随受资gas提升总利用率;理论上对策略性操纵具有鲁棒性,提出了一种可实施的时间维度流动性机制。

Abstract: Transactions differ in how their value changes with execution time and relative position. Ethereum's EIP-1559 lets them compete through fee fields, but a fee bid gives no enforceable claim to an earlier position in the block, and no way to express willingness to accept a later one. Its base fee is a hard admission floor. We introduce temporal liquidity markets (TLM), a framework for crossing complementary temporal requirements: transactions seeking early-region execution (consumers) can fund transactions that opt into exclusion from that region (providers). Selected consumers complete within the early region and are ordered among themselves by authorization density, both validator-checked. In our block-local EIP-1559 extension, providers may be admitted below the base-fee floor. Under TLM regulation, funding-conditioned and capacity-capped provider gas is excluded from the ordinary EIP-1559 controller input. Counting it there instead raises the base fee and displaces ordinary demand at a positive base-fee fixed point. Exclusion lets the controller regulate ordinary demand at its original target and preserves the no-TLM ordinary allocation by construction; in synthetic experiments it raises total utilization with funded gas. Selected consumers pay their signed authorizations, which fund provider shortfalls; the surplus is burned. We state an adversary model with strategic senders and builders and prove eight properties under it, among them validator-checked rule validity, full burn of the base fee, and no subsidy. An inserted consumer bid cannot raise any other consumer's charge. With a provider fee-cap floor, a small, capped inclusion fee and a consumer allowance tied to funded provider gas by a large enough link ratio, no finite set of consumer bids or providers that the builder inserts raises its direct fee payoff.

</details>


### [343] [Fast Iterative Combinatorial Auctions via Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30667)
*Luis F. Paul Tosta,Quinn Arnold,Gianluca Brero*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出FastCombo，用深度强化学习离线学习迭代组合拍卖中的序贯定价策略，将最小化清算轮数建模为POMDP，从而既减少拍卖轮数又大幅降低在线计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代组合拍卖（频谱分配、运输、工业采购）中每一轮成本高昂。贝叶斯定价虽能显著减少轮数，但依赖单步目标且需反复在线推断与优化；论文还证明：即使已知真实估值分布，贪心地最大化即时清算概率也可能比"有信息量"的策略需要任意多倍的轮数。

Method: 将单 minded 拍卖中最小化期望清算轮数的目标形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）；离线学习价格策略，把信用分配给"为未来决策创造条件"的查询；采用循环式竞标者-物品图策略网络，在完整拍卖轨迹上训练；在线每次价格更新只需一次神经网络前向传播。

Result: 单物品实验中，五个训练策略均学到有信息量的开局，期望轮数从1.85降至1.65（对比贝叶斯单步规则）；在组合拍卖测试套件（CATS）的四个领域上，FastCombo 取得有竞争力的清算效果，同时把每次拍卖的在线价格选择时间相对标准贝叶斯基线降低约300–900倍。

Conclusion: 学习序贯价格策略在信息获取与在线计算效率两方面均有价值；离线强化学习可替代昂贵的在线贝叶斯推断，为迭代组合拍卖提供实用的定价方案。

Abstract: Iterative combinatorial auctions are used in spectrum allocation, transportation, and industrial procurement, but rounds are costly. We introduce FastCombo, a deep reinforcement learning approach to sequential price discovery. Bayesian pricing has sharply reduced auction rounds even against subgradient benchmarks tuned with hindsight for each instance, but relies on a one-step objective and repeated online inference and optimization. We prove that greedily maximizing immediate clearing probability can require arbitrarily more rounds in expectation than an informative policy, even with the true valuation distribution known. FastCombo learns price policies offline, assigning credit to queries for the future decisions they enable and producing each online price update with a single neural-network forward pass. We formulate the objective of minimizing expected rounds to clearing in single-minded auctions as a partially observable Markov decision process and train a recurrent bidder-item graph policy over complete auction trajectories. In a one-item experiment, all five trained policies learn an informative opening, reducing expected rounds from 1.85 to 1.65 relative to the tested Bayesian one-step rule. Across four domains from the Combinatorial Auction Test Suite, FastCombo achieves competitive clearing while reducing measured online price-selection time per auction by a factor of roughly 300-900 relative to the standard Bayesian baseline. These results demonstrate the value of learning sequential price policies for both information acquisition and online computational efficiency.

</details>


### [344] [A Weakly Group Strategy-Proof and Pareto-Stable Matching Mechanism with Two-Sided Indifferences under Gross Substitutes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30807)
*Yasushi Kawase,Ryosuke Sato*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究双方均存在无差异的有限多对一匹配市场，在企业偏好属于总替代(GS)表示这一大类（含非响应性偏好）下，构造了一个确定性的广义延迟接受机制，同时实现弱稳定、双向帕累托有效、工人弱群体策略防策略，并在给定GS值预言机时于强多项式时间内可计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准做法是随机打破平局后运行延迟接受，虽对工人策略防策略，但可能选出一个在原始偏好下被帕累托支配的弱稳定匹配。作者希望在不依赖随机破平局的前提下，直接得到兼顾稳定与效率的匹配结果，并把无差异的序数匹配与非完全可转移效用下的竞争均衡联系起来。

Method: 针对每家企业偏好可容许总替代(GS)表示的市场（覆盖拟阵约束下的可加评分、指派价值等非响应性偏好），构造确定性广义延迟接受机制；机制仅使用序数比较，但等价于求解一个分层辅助市场的均衡，该均衡返回卖方最优均衡匹配，进而导出稳定、效率与激励性质；给定GS表示的值预言机，可在强多项式时间内实现。

Result: 所构造机制返回的匹配是弱稳定的，且对双方帕累托有效；对工人满足弱群体策略防策略性；在GS值预言机下于强多项式时间可实现。该机制返回分层辅助市场的卖方最优均衡匹配。

Conclusion: 论文在市场与机制性质之间建立了桥梁：即便只做序数比较，也能借助分层辅助市场的均衡结构，在无差异匹配中同时获得稳定、双向效率与较强的激励保证，推广了传统延迟接受在无差异与GS偏好下的适用范围。

Abstract: We study finite many-to-one matching markets with indifferences on both sides and publicly known firm preferences over sets of workers. A standard approach breaks ties uniformly at random and runs deferred acceptance, which is strategy-proof for workers but may select a weakly stable matching that is Pareto dominated under the agents' original preferences. For the broad class of markets in which each firm's preferences admit a gross substitutes (GS) representation, we construct a deterministic generalized deferred acceptance mechanism that is weakly stable, Pareto efficient with respect to both sides, worker weakly group strategy-proof, and implementable in strongly polynomial time given value oracles for the GS representations. This domain includes nonresponsive firm preferences, such as additive scores under matroid constraints and assignment values. Our analysis bridges ordinal matching with indifferences and competitive equilibria under imperfectly transferable utility. Although the mechanism uses only ordinal comparisons, it returns a seller-optimal equilibrium matching of a tiered auxiliary market, and the equilibrium structure of this market yields the stability, efficiency, and incentive guarantees.

</details>


### [345] [Equilibria and Learning in Competitive Market Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30891)
*Matteo Onger,Luigi Foscari*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出一个N≥2个策略性做市商与单一非策略代表性交易者之间的做市博弈，刻画纯策略纳什均衡(PSNE)的存在性及其与波动率的关系，并通过价格离散化建立无内部遗憾学习趋于连续Nash价格包络的理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续报价空间下有限博弈论证不适用，非凸且不连续的支付函数使经典连续存在性结果失效并增加学习难度，因此需要一个能刻画多做大商竞争均衡且可学习的理论框架。

Method: 构建N≥2策略性做市商与代表性交易者的做市博弈；在连续报价空间中证明PSNE存在性；分析买卖价差与资产价值波动率的单调关系；对价格离散化并在额外正则条件下证明无内部遗憾学习者的时间平均策略随tick size消失收敛到连续Nash价格包络；最后用数值模拟验证。

Result: 在资产价值分布的最小假设下至少存在一个PSNE；均衡买卖价差随资产价值波动率严格变宽；离散化下无内部遗憾学习的时间平均行为收敛到连续Nash价格包络；数值模拟支持理论结论。

Conclusion: 该工作为多策略做市商竞争提供了存在性与比较静态结果，并建立了从离散学习动态到连续均衡的桥梁，兼具理论刻画与可计算性。 

Abstract: We propose a market-making game played among $N \ge 2$ strategic market makers and a single non-strategic representative trader. In a continuous quote space, standard finite-game arguments do not apply, while non-convex and discontinuous payoffs rule out classical continuous existence results and complicate learning. Nonetheless, we characterize pure-strategy Nash equilibria (PSNEs) and show that at least one PSNE always exists under minimal assumptions on the underlying asset value distribution, and that the equilibrium bid-ask spread widens strictly with asset value volatility. To obtain a tractable learning framework, we discretize prices and, under an additional regularity condition, show that the time-averaged play of no-internal-regret learners approaches the continuous Nash price envelope as the tick size vanishes. Finally, we empirically validate our theoretical results through numerical simulations.

</details>


### [346] [Truthful by Omission: Click Thinning for LLM-Native Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30999)
*Junhua Liu,Zhicheng Liang,Zejun Zhang,Langzhou He,Feng Qian*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 针对生成式AI助手中嵌入广告的分配问题，提出"点击稀释"机制，在保证期望真实性的同时达到至少一半的最优福利。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统位置拍卖不再适用：广告点击率取决于所在段落，且用户首次点击即停导致广告间争抢点击，更高出价反而可能使竞价者失去点击，使真实性难以保证。现有机制要么福利近似有常数比但真实性未知，要么真实但保证随段落数增加而退化。

Method: 在答题内容和编辑顺序提前固定的设定下，假设已知广告被看到时的点击率且不受省略其他广告影响。核心思想是"点击稀释"：随机省略广告，使早位广告展示更少，从而每个广告的总点击概率不再依赖其排序位置。此时福利最大化约化为可解的匹配问题，用VCG式支付精确求解使真实出价在期望意义下最优。进一步刻画省略可达到的点击概率，将近似比从2收紧到 2-(1-δ)^{K-1}（最多展示K个广告、每个点击率不超过δ）。

Result: 给出计算高效的机制，在自由重排下实现期望真实性，并达到至少1/2最优福利；当最多展示K个广告且点击率上限为δ时，近似比为 2-(1-δ)^{K-1}，且该因子对任何保序规则都是最优的，即真实性与计算效率不带来额外的最坏情况损失。

Conclusion: 通过点击稀释将含争抢效应的广告分配转化为匹配问题，同时实现期望真实性与恒定福利保证，并证明近似比在保序规则类中达到理论最优。

Abstract: Generative AI assistants are becoming an advertising medium, embedding sponsored content in their answers. This setting departs from classical position auctions in two ways: an ad's click-through rate depends on the passage that hosts it, and because users stop at their first click, earlier ads take clicks from later ones. This competition for clicks makes truthfulness delicate: a higher bid can reshape the allocation and put a competitor ahead of the bidder, reducing the bidder's clicks. Existing mechanisms either attain a constant fraction of the optimal welfare (advertisers' total click value) but are not known to be truthful, or are truthful but their welfare guarantee degrades as the number of passages grows. We achieve both even when the answer and its editorial order are fixed before bidding. Assuming each ad's click-through rate when reached is known and unaffected by omitting other ads, we give a computationally efficient mechanism that is truthful in expectation and attains at least half the optimal welfare under free reordering.
  Our key idea, click thinning, omits ads at random, showing earlier ads less often so that each ad's overall click probability no longer depends on the order of the ads. Welfare maximization then reduces to a tractable matching problem, and solving it exactly with VCG-style payments makes truthful bidding optimal in expectation. Characterizing the click probabilities that omission can achieve sharpens the approximation factor from $2$ to $2-(1-δ)^{K-1}$ when at most $K$ ads are shown and each click-through rate is at most $δ$. This factor is the best possible for any order-preserving rule, even one that ignores incentives and computation, so truthfulness and computational efficiency incur no additional worst-case loss.

</details>


### [347] [Matching Tasks to Agents: Mechanism Design for Multi-Agent Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31002)
*Matteo Bollini,Matteo Castiglioni,Alberto Marchesi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究逆向选择与道德风险下的任务分配问题，给出了单任务情形下简洁的Myerson式刻画与多项式时间最优机制，并证明紧的Θ(1/(NK))利润比界；多任务情形最优机制可能不存在，但对常数个代理人给出多项式时间近似方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务分配中代理人私下知道自身类型（决定成功概率与努力成本），且努力不可观测，导致最优贝叶斯合同设计一般计算不可行，经典Myerson刻画也无法直接推广到隐藏行动加多维私人信息的情形，因此需要新的可计算刻画。

Method: 单任务设定下，代理人报告类型，委托人据此选人并提供与成功挂钩的支付。关键洞察是激励相容约束只依赖于"努力成本/成功概率"之比，由此给出Myerson式刻画并设计多项式时间算法求最优机制；再将分析推广到多任务情形。

Result: 单任务问题可多项式时间求解最优机制；最优利润与完全信息基准之比的最坏情形紧界为Θ(1/(NK))（N为代理人数，K为每人类型数）。多任务下最优机制可能不存在，但对常数个代理人可在多项式时间内近似其利润上确界。

Conclusion: 尽管多维私人信息与隐藏行动一般使合同设计难解，单任务情形仍具有简洁可计算的最优机制结构；多任务情形的最优性不再保证，但可用近似算法处理。

Abstract: We study task assignment under adverse selection and moral hazard. In the single-task setting, agents privately know their types, which determine their success probabilities and effort costs. Based on the agents' reported types, the principal selects an agent to perform the task and offers a success-contingent payment. Although optimal Bayesian contract design is generally computationally intractable and Myerson's characterization does not directly extend to settings with hidden actions and multidimensional private information, we show that the single-task problem admits a simple Myerson-style characterization. Our key insight is that incentive constraints depend only on the ratio between effort cost and success probability. We characterize an optimal mechanism and show that it can be computed in polynomial time. We also establish a tight $Θ(1/(NK))$ worst-case bound on the ratio between the optimal profit and the full-information benchmark, where $N$ is the number of agents and $K$ is the number of types per agent. We then extend our analysis to multiple tasks, showing that an optimal mechanism may not exist. Nevertheless, for a constant number of agents, we provide a polynomial-time approximation scheme for the supremum profit.

</details>


### [348] [Balanced Posted Prices in Stationary Two-Sided Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31153)
*Ilan Reuven Cohen*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文研究有限库存的中间商在双边到达市场中统一定价，证明对XOS买家可用多项式时间计算的静态价格保证基准收益的一半，并提出"贡献平衡"与"速率平衡"原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中间商从到达的卖家买入、向到达的买家卖出不可损耗商品，但库存有限、且无法预知未来到达。核心问题是：在不知道未来到达信息的静态定价下，长期收益能达到最优（可掌握未来信息、无限库存的线性规划基准）的多大比例。

Method: 建立长期平均购买/分配速率的线性规划基准（有/无未来信息均相同最优值）。对XOS买家，构造静态共同价格，通过对需求和支撑值查询在多项式时间内算出。价格设计依据两条平衡原则：(1) 贡献平衡——使买卖双方对贸易收益的逐项下界（扣除采购成本后）相等；(2) 速率平衡——在检验库存可用性之前，使价格所选定的购买率与销售率相等。

Result: 对任意有限物品容量（即使每件物品只有一个存储位），该静态价格保证基准收益的1/2；且与平局打破方式无关、不需未来信息。单物品情形下速率平衡给出紧的保证 C/(C+1)（C为容量）。

Conclusion: 两类平衡原则将经典先知不等式（1/2期望基准与中位数阈值）的证明思路推广到有限库存的重复双边市场，给出了与未来信息无关的静态价格近似保证，并刻画了容量对保证比例的影响。

Abstract: We study an intermediary that buys nonperishing items from arriving sellers and sells them to arriving buyers, subject to limited storage. Sellers and buyers arrive according to independent Poisson processes. The intermediary pays and charges the same fixed item prices, aiming to maximize long-run gains from trade: buyer value minus seller cost. Our benchmark may choose allocations directly, has unlimited storage, and must purchase each unit before allocating it. Its optimal long-run gain rate equals the value of a linear program of average purchase and allocation rates, with or without knowledge of future arrivals.
  For buyers whose bundle values are maxima of nonnegative additive valuations (XOS), we compute static common prices that guarantee half of this benchmark for arbitrary finite item capacities, even one storage slot per item, regardless of how ties are resolved without using future arrivals. The prices are computable in polynomial time using demand and supporting-value queries. The construction equalizes itemwise lower bounds on buyer and seller contributions to gains from trade, accounting for procurement costs. We call this contribution balance. As a single-item foundation, we also equalize the rates of purchases and sales selected by the price, before checking inventory availability. We call this rate balance. For capacity $C$, it yields the tight guarantee $C/(C+1)$. The two principles parallel proofs of the classical prophet inequality based on half the expected benchmark and on a median threshold, adapting these balancing ideas to recurring two-sided markets with limited inventory.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [349] [The Cost of Saying Hello: An Empirical Study of Handshake Overhead in AI Agent Communication Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30151)
*Pranav Varshney*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个按阶段拆解的智能体协议握手实证基准：往返次数主导耗时，但元数据token成本随能力数量线性增长，可占大上下文窗口的11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 调研普遍将握手开销列为智能体通信协议的效率指标，但从未有实测数据；本文填补这一空白。

Method: 使用各协议官方SDK，对MCP（2025 initialize版与2026 discover版）、A2A、ACP的每个握手请求插桩，测量往返次数、分阶段延迟、线缆字节与token成本；覆盖冷启动、热重连、能力不匹配、元数据退化场景，每格N=50，在loopback与模拟50ms RTT下测试。

Result: 往返次数主导握手成本：旧版MCP需3次往返、50ms RTT下230ms；A2A仅1次往返、61.0ms。LLM读取对端元数据时，每项能力耗24–107 token，200项能力的对端将吃掉200k上下文窗口的11%。MCP 2026修订版将握手从3次往返降至2次，配合era pinning在热重连时降为0次。

Conclusion: 握手成本主要由往返次数决定，但元数据token开销同样不可忽视；协议演进（MCP 2026）佐证了本文测得的成本。作者开源了完整测试框架、原始数据与分析代码。

Abstract: Every interaction between AI agents begins with a handshake: the initiating agent must locate its counterpart, learn what it can do, and establish a session before the first useful message can be sent. Surveys of agent communication protocols name handshake overhead as an efficiency criterion, yet none report measurements. This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of the handshake in three major agent protocols: MCP (in both its 2025 initialize and 2026 discover eras), A2A, and ACP. Using each protocol's official SDK, we instrument every request for round trips, per-phase latency, wire bytes, and token cost across cold-start, warm-repeat, capability-mismatch, and degraded-metadata scenarios (N=50 per cell, on loopback and under an emulated 50 ms RTT). Round-trip count dominates handshake cost. A legacy MCP handshake takes three round trips and 230 ms at 50 ms RTT; A2A needs one round trip and 61.0 ms. Round trips are not the whole bill: when an LLM reads the counterpart's metadata, handshake cost scales with the counterpart's capability inventory at 24-107 tokens per capability, so a 200-capability counterpart spends 11% of a 200k-token context window before the agent reads its own task. MCP's own 2026 revision cuts its handshake from three round trips to two and, with era pinning, to zero on warm reconnects, protocol evolution that corroborates the cost we measure. We release the full harness, raw data, and analysis at https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark.

</details>


### [350] [MCP vs CLI for AI Agents: A Comparative Analysis of Tool Integration Strategies for Autonomous Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30157)
*Arun Malik,Nitish Talasu,Bradley Klemick,Vineet Tushar Trivedi,Prachi Shah,Sanay Devi,Junjie Zhang,Kunal Sonawane*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文比较AI智能体接口的两大范式——CLI（直接执行shell命令）与MCP（结构化JSON-RPC受控工具访问），从14个维度、安全合规、经济建模三方面进行分析，结论是本地单用户场景CLI更高效，MCP在细粒度访问控制、凭据隔离、审计与多租户治理上不可替代，并建议生产系统采用混合架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体需要与文件、API、数据库、云服务等外部系统交互，业界出现了CLI与MCP两种竞争性接口范式，但缺乏系统性的对比与选型依据，因此需要一项多维度、结合安全与成本的比较分析来指导实践。

Method: 构建14个评估维度的对比框架，辅以实例演示；并对标既有合规框架（如NSA正式指南、OWASP安全标准）进行安全评估，同时结合BCG与Gartner的经济模型开展成本分析；此外考察渐进式披露技术对MCP上下文开销的影响。

Result: CLI在单用户、纯本地工作流中效率更高；MCP则在细粒度访问控制、凭据隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理等CLI本质无法满足的需求上具备优势。渐进式披露可消除MCP历史上token开销大的弱点，使其token效率与CLI相当，同时保留其架构收益。

Conclusion: 两者并非对立替代关系，而应按场景分工：生产系统宜采用混合架构，以MCP承载治理与安全需求、以CLI支撑高效本地操作，从而兼顾效率、安全与合规。

Abstract: AI agents require interfaces to interact with external systems such as files, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Two competing paradigms have emerged: CLI (Command Line Interface), where agents execute shell commands directly, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), a structured JSON-RPC protocol providing governed, typed tool access. This paper presents a comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions, supported by worked examples, security assessment against established compliance frameworks, and economic modeling. Our analysis indicates that CLI provides superior efficiency for single-user, local-only workflows, while MCP addresses requirements that CLI fundamentally cannot satisfy, including fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured audit, and multi-tenant governance. We further examine how progressive disclosure techniques eliminate MCP's historical weakness (context window overhead), yielding token efficiency comparable to CLI while preserving its architectural benefits. A hybrid architecture is recommended for production systems. This analysis draws upon academic, government, and industry sources including NSA formal guidance (CSI U/OO/6030316-26), OWASP security standards, and economic modeling from BCG and Gartner.

</details>


### [351] [Accelerating Wildfire Hazard Mapping Across Canada with an AI Surrogate Modelling Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30170)
*Hager Radi Abdelwahed,Toluwaleke Olutayo,Chirag Goel,Jana Osea,Aldo Zaimi,Tom Swystun,Sandy Erni,Francisco Emiliano Lopez Saavedra,Yan Boulanger,Gaétan Marceau Caron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AI代理模型(surrogate)替代BurnP3+的蒙特卡洛野火模拟，多任务深度学习在全国尺度上快速预测燃烧概率、平均火强度和蔓延速率，单区域实现806倍CPU加速、仅用13%内存，且保持下游灾害分类与物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加拿大野火活动加剧，需频繁全国性灾害制图以支持燃料管理、土地利用规划、基础设施保护和疏散路线。但BurnP3/BurnP3+等基于过程的模拟依赖计算密集的蒙特卡洛方法，单个区域建模单元耗时数天到数周，难以支撑快速情景分析。

Method: AI研究者与野火建模专家合作：(a) 建立标准化框架，用于训练、微调和对照过程型模拟器评估AI代理模型；(b) 训练多任务深度学习代理模型，融合燃料、地形、点火可能性等地理空间数据与区域气象，同时模拟燃烧概率、平均火强度和平均蔓延速率；(c) 设计领域专用指标与反事实评估协议，检验分布外泛化能力。

Result: 模型近似BurnP3+输出，在一致性、秩相关、误差和空间重叠指标上表现良好；保留下游灾害分类结果；对专家设计的反事实干预产生物理上合理的响应；代表性区域上端到端CPU加速806倍，主机内存仅占BurnP3+的13%。

Conclusion: 代理模型可在极低成本下有效逼近过程型野火模拟器，支持快速全国尺度灾害制图与情景分析；但其可靠性依赖标准化评估与反事实检验，分布外泛化仍需关注。

Abstract: Canada's increasing wildfire activity requires frequent national hazard mapping to guide proactive mitigation, including fuel management, land-use planning, infrastructure protection, and evacuation routing. However, process-based wildfire simulation frameworks (e.g., BurnP3 and BurnP3+) rely on computationally intensive Monte Carlo simulations to model burn probability, fire intensity, and rate of spread. These workflows can take days to weeks to process a single regional modelling unit. To overcome these computational bottlenecks, we present three contributions developed through collaboration between AI researchers and wildfire modelling experts: (a) a standardized framework for training, fine-tuning, and evaluating AI surrogate models against process-based wildfire simulators; (b) a multi-task deep learning surrogate trained on national-scale data to emulate burn probability, mean fire intensity, and mean rate of spread at a fraction of the computational cost (seconds); and (c) domain-specific metrics and counterfactual evaluation protocols to probe out-of-distribution generalization. Integrating geospatial data (fuel, terrain, ignition likelihood) and regional weather, our model approximates BurnP3+ simulation outputs, achieving strong performance across agreement, rank-correlation, error, and spatial-overlap metrics. It preserves downstream hazard classifications and produces physically plausible responses to expert-informed counterfactual interventions. On a representative region, the surrogate achieves 806-fold end-to-end CPU acceleration and uses 13% of BurnP3+'s host memory, facilitating rapid scenario analysis.

</details>


### [352] [Neural Networks with Differentiable Belief-Function Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30173)
*Antonin Sulc*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出用Yager组合规则构建深度证据网络,使输出mass中的无知量m(Θ)可作为无需标注者分布的“我不知道”信号,并用于不确定性与OOD检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dempster归一化因子(1-κ)⁻¹在反向传播时产生(1-κ)⁻²梯度项,在证据冲突时发散;Yager规则是双线性的,无此问题,且在高冲突下把mass重分配给无知集,更符合认识论。

Method: 构造端到端深度证据流水线:从多头到输出的每一层mass均为合法的Dempster–Shafer mass函数,统一用Yager规则⊞组合;用硬标签训练,从不接触标注者分布;以输出m(Θ)作为无知/弃权信号;并与Dempster归一化版本对比,分析梯度稳定性。

Result: m(Θ)在视觉(CIFAR-10H)与语言两种模态上能对人为分歧排序;Dempster版本也能排序相近,但其归一化把冲突除掉,在最受争议图像上Yager的无知量是Dempster的9倍,因而只有Yager可直接读作无知量;OOD检测上与强单遍基线竞争力相当,而得分更高但需clamp的Dempster变体在去掉clamp后梯度不稳定。

Conclusion: Yager规则在梯度上更稳健,且其输出m(Θ)可未重校准地解释为无知量,是构建深度证据不确定性估计的合适基础;归一化Dempster规则虽在OOD分数上可占优,但依赖clamp且梯度不稳。

Abstract: Yager's 1987 rule of combination $\boxplus$ was proposed on epistemic grounds: under high conflict, mass should be redistributed to ignorance rather than renormalised onto the class simplex. We observe that backpropagation needs the same rule: Dempster's normaliser $(1{-}κ)^{-1}$, where $κ$ is the conflict mass, puts a $(1{-}κ)^{-2}$ term in the gradient that diverges exactly when evidence sources disagree, while Yager's $\boxplus$ is bilinear and has no such term. Building on this, we construct a deep evidential pipeline in which every mass in the chain from heads to output is a valid Dempster--Shafer mass function, combined by Yager's rule. The output mass on the ignorance set, $m(Θ)$, serves as the network's ``I do not know'' signal. The network is fit to hard labels and never sees an annotator distribution, yet $m(Θ)$ orders human disagreement in two modalities, visual and linguistic. Dempster's rises too and ranks contested inputs about as well, but its normaliser divides the conflict out: Yager's vacuity is $9\times$ larger on the most contested CIFAR-10H images, so only Yager's is readable as an amount of ignorance without recalibration. For out-of-distribution detection it is competitive with strong single-pass baselines, while the clamped Dempster variant that scores higher becomes gradient-unstable once the clamp is removed.

</details>


### [353] [When Stable and Preferred Semantics Agree: A Path-Based Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30176)
*Yan Zhang,Kehan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文基于攻击图中的路径集合及由其诱导的二元关系，给出 preferred 与 stable 语义一致的统一判据，并推广了 Dung 有限争议性与 SCC-对称两个经典条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: preferred 与 stable 语义何时一致是抽象论证中的核心问题，已有判据（Dung 的 limited controversiality、SCC-symmetry）彼此独立且缺乏统一框架，作者希望找到更一般、可实例化的结构条件。

Method: 选取攻击图中适当的路径集合，构造其诱导的二元关系，建立基于路径的一般性判据；再以不同路径类实例化，将条件表达为相应关系良基性（well-foundedness）。取偶数路径即退化为 Dung 结果；并引入两个无限路径集序列，其中一个满足 Collapse Theorem（无穷多条良基性条件归约为三条本质不同的条件）。

Result: 所得条件严格推广了 Dung 的有限争议性条件与 SCC-对称条件；第一个路径序列的良基性条件可坍缩为三类，第二个序列则给出真正互异、无坍缩的条件族。结论同时适用于有限与无限论证框架，有限情形下有简化表述。

Conclusion: 路径—关系—良基性框架为 preferred/stable 一致性提供了统一且可推广的结构判据，并可作为 stable 扩展存在性的充分条件。

Abstract: We investigate structural conditions under which preferred and stable semantics agree in abstract argumentation frameworks. Our approach is based on suitably chosen sets of paths in the attack graph and binary relations induced by them. We establish a general path-based criterion for semantic agreement and instantiate it with several classes of paths, obtaining sufficient conditions expressed in terms of well-foundedness of the corresponding relations.
  The resulting conditions strictly generalize two principal structural criteria for preferred and stable agreement in the literature: Dung's limited controversiality condition and the SCC-symmetry condition. In particular, Dung's result is recovered as a special case by taking the relevant path set to be the set of even paths. We further introduce two infinite sequences of path sets, each yielding a family of agreement conditions. For the first sequence, a Collapse Theorem reduces the infinitely many associated well-foundedness conditions to three essentially distinct ones, whereas the second sequence gives rise to genuinely distinct conditions with no analogous collapse. Our results apply to both finite and infinite argumentation frameworks, admit simplified formulations in the finite case, and also yield sufficient conditions for the existence of stable extensions.

</details>


### [354] [Feedback That Backfires in Games: Do LLM Players Repeat the Move They Just Watched Fail?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30205)
*Esmail Gumaan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在Sokoban、Connect Four、Othello三个游戏中检验"失败记录"（把非法或致败走子与失败信息写入上下文）是否会诱导小模型更可能重复失败走子，结果显示在8个指令微调模型上记录整体起反作用（纠正增益G=-1.38 nats/token），且该效应与模型、失败类型有关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用中观察到小模型会因上下文中记录失败而更倾向重复失败动作，作者想验证这一"失败记录反噬"现象是否在游戏环境中同样成立，并弄清其机制与影响因素。

Method: 构造固定探针项（对正确走子做扰动），在Sokoban/Connect Four/Othello中精确判定"非法"与"合法但致败"两类失败；对8个指令微调模型（135M–1.7B）测量失败记录对失败走子似然影响；辅以探索性分析（走子log-prob斜率、贪心解码行为）、OLMo 2 1B后训练阶梯、RAGEN默认模型、以及"不要重复"指令与解码器禁用等干预对比；全部在float32、免费Colab GPU上测量并复现原论文数值。

Result: 汇总G=-1.38 nats/token，记录使失败走子更可能，主要通过走子的表层形式起作用，主要见于非法走子而非致败走子，且并非所有模型都出现。记录后失败走子log-prob对先前概率的斜率仅0.18（近乎不保留原偏好）：本不会走的走子变可能且贪心解码开始产生，本将走的走子变不可能但贪心仍重复38%。省略走子字符串的失败描述可保留原偏好。OLMo 2 1B基础模型即存在反转，DPO阶段基本消除；RAGEN默认模型在RL前的自有Sokoban格式中已反转。

Conclusion: "记录失败再重试"的harness模式在小模型中会诱发失败走子重复，机制偏向表层字符串匹配而非语义失败推理；描述性反馈优于原文记录，简单指令与解码器禁用收效有限；后训练（DPO）可缓解该问题，提示harness设计与后训练阶段需协同考虑。

Abstract: When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.

</details>


### [355] [Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30277)
*Yuri Chervonyi,Sergei Gukov,Thang Luong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"人-AI发现回路"，借助AI代理的原型开发、分布式大规模搜索与精确符号验证，导出五参数"广义Boyd算法"，对每个目标偶数度d均可构造Mahler测度严格小于α₁≈1.255434的不可约整系数多项式，消除度数跳空，并在d≤2000范围内刷新6项纪录、保持99.6%最优记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lehmer问题（1933）询问整系数多项式Mahler测度能否任意小，而该问题依赖大规模计算探查与分析综合才能揭示的结构。此前小Mahler测度不可约多项式的系统构造只覆盖偶数度d≤180；更高次上Boyd解析单参数族经常可约化，跳过近50%目标度数，缺乏对任意d的通用构造。

Method: 构建人-AI发现回路：在对话式提示基础上扩展快速数值流水线、精确符号验证器与大规模分布式搜索。AI代理本地原型化数值与符号求解器，跨分布式集群并行搜索，并与人类研究者协同提取、验证数学假设，最终归纳出五参数广义Boyd算法。

Result: 广义Boyd算法消除度数跳空，对每个目标偶数度都构造出不可约整系数多项式且Mahler测度严格低于Boyd极限点α₁≈1.255434；在d≤2000全部偶数度上评估，改进6个已发表数值，占有99.6%的最优已知记录，并发布经验证的最小Mahler测度多项式数据集。

Conclusion: AI可有效参与数学发现闭环：通过数值搜索、符号验证与人类假设提炼的协同，把计算规模化优势转化为新的数学构造，并为Lehmer问题相关研究提供可复用的算法与公开数据集。

Abstract: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search.
